en: I only mean to say that this boring, lustful thought—when the hormones surge—will, the moment he sees a woman, really and suddenly conjure up countless fantasy scenarios anytime and anywhere.

en: Boys are creatures who constantly battle with desire; no matter how powerful or wealthy, there are times when they cannot control their own consciousness.

en: Having said that, I want to speak seriously: when you meet a boy you should not be flirting with, don't go testing your own charm. Boys lose control far too easily and end up in a situation beyond redemption, only then realising that none of it should have happened.

text: 当然看着街上穿着暴露者就动色心而施行不应该做的事情的男生，那个是赤裸裸的禽兽了，不能算是人类。
en: Of course, a boy who, upon seeing someone dressed provocatively in the street, is moved by lust and does what he should not—that one is a naked beast, not to be counted as human.

text: *你没非份之想，你没意淫，那么很好，很君子，可是不用批判我。

en: As a gay man and also a grown man with rich social experience.

en: Drawing on my own experience and research, I'd like to share my insights with you!

text: 在这个世界上做人真的很难，特别是男人，特别是gay，柜柜交友上有一位g友是这么说的，他们所面临的生活压力确实很大。
en: It's truly hard to live in this world, especially for men, especially for gay men. As one gay friend said on a gay dating platform, the life pressure they face is indeed great.

text: 为了生计，他们不惜一切代价努力拼搏；为了生计，他们总是把自己最真实的一面深藏心窝；为了生计，他们忍辱负重受尽人间甘苦，天大的事一人硬扛，无从诉说，也不会与人倾诉。
en: For a living, they strive at all costs; for a living, they always hide their truest selves deep in their hearts; for a living, they bear humiliation and endure all the bitterness of life, shouldering even the greatest troubles alone, with no one to tell and no one they would confide in.

text: 在外他们经风沥雨，承载着巨大的生活压力，强颜应对世态炎凉，以至于身心憔悴。
en: Outside, they weather the wind and rain, carrying enormous life pressure, forcing a smile to cope with the fickleness of the world, until they are physically and mentally exhausted.

text: 回到这个避风的港湾——家，又怕给家人带来不愉快，又怕家人不理解他们为什么和别人不一样，所以只好强装笑脸，应对家人以营造和谐氛围。
en: Returning to this shelter from the storm—home—they fear bringing unhappiness to their family, and fear their family won't understand why they are different from others, so they can only put on a smile and deal with their family to create a harmonious atmosphere.

text: 为了缓解心理压力，他们抽烟，他们喝酒，经常把自己灌得酩酊大醉，麻痹自己的神经，陋习不少，以逃避现实所造成的压力，但这原本不是他们本来的样子。
en: To relieve psychological pressure, they smoke, they drink, often getting themselves dead drunk to numb their nerves; they have many bad habits, to escape the pressure reality brings, but this was not their original nature.

text: 他们虚伪，把自己包裹的严严实实，出没于社交场所。
en: They are hypocritical, wrapping themselves up tightly, appearing in social settings.

en: In dealing with people and matters they are smooth and slick, ingratiating themselves everywhere, handling things tactfully, and behaving with servile humility.

en: Siyao Shi turned her face away in embarrassment and gave a low reply.

text: 祁深明显看出了她的局促不安，在她眼角吻了一下。
en: Shen Qi clearly saw her unease and kissed her at the corner of her eye.

text: “别怕。
en: “Don't be afraid.

text: 意识完全是飘忽的，感知却异常明朗。
en: Her consciousness was utterly adrift, yet her perception was unusually clear.

text: 彻底清醒后，时思遥依旧觉得今天发生的一切都像在梦里，荒唐不已。
en: After coming fully to her senses, Siyao Shi still felt everything that happened today was like a dream, utterly absurd.

text: 两个月前，她挽着周治学的手臂参加南大校友聚会，祁深作为南大的杰出校友兼他们院里曾经特聘的教授，还夸过他们郎才女貌。
en: Two months ago, she attended a Nanjing University alumni gathering on the arm of Zhixue Zhou. Shen Qi, as an outstanding alumnus of Nanjing University and a formerly specially-appointed professor in their faculty, had even praised them as a fine couple—he handsome, she beautiful.

text: 现在周治学出轨，即将迎娶豪门千金。
en: Now Zhixue Zhou has cheated, and is about to marry a rich heiress.

text: 而她，竟和祁深有了这样的牵扯。
en: And she—she has actually become entangled with Shen Qi in this way.

text: 祁家在金陵权势无双，祁深本来不是继承人，几年前却突然弃文从商，一举接手了祁家的长丰集团，现在，已经是金陵城里最炙手可热的人物。
en: The Qi family is unrivalled in power in Jinling. Shen Qi was not originally the heir, but a few years ago he abruptly left his academic post for business, and in one move took over the Qi family's Changfeng Group; now he is the most sought-after figure in Jinling.

text: 这男人在人前光风霁月，刚才却跟换了个人似的。
en: This man is upright and brilliant in public, yet just now he seemed like a different person.

text: 她差点以为自己要交代在这里了。
en: She almost thought she would meet her end here.

text: 彻底平静后，时思遥抱紧衣服，软在后座上久久不能动。
en: After she was completely calm, Siyao Shi hugged her clothes tightly and lay limp on the back seat, unable to move for a long time.

text: 耳边一番窸窣声，她侧过脸看去，黯淡光影在车里流转，视线模糊，却也能描摹出男人得体从容的人前模样。
en: There was a rustling by her ear; she turned her face to look, dim light and shadow flowing in the car. Her vision was blurry, yet she could still sketch out the man's composed and poised public appearance.

text: 他点了根烟，问她：“碰了脏东西？
en: He lit a cigarette and asked her: “Touched something dirty?

text: 原来他发现了。
en: So he had noticed.

text: 时思遥抱紧衣服坐起身，用头发挡住了脸，闷闷应了一声。
en: Siyao Shi sat up hugging her clothes, shielding her face with her hair, and gave a muffled reply.

text: “同事做的？
en: “Done by a colleague?

text: 祁深的语调没有太多起伏，时思遥攥紧了手，忍不住一阵犯恶心。
en: Shen Qi's tone had little inflection; Siyao Shi clenched her hands and could not help feeling a wave of nausea.

text: 周治学出轨乔琳宣，她认了，提了分手。
en: Zhixue Zhou cheated with Linxuan Qiao; she accepted it and proposed the breakup.

text: 可周治学偏偏纠缠不休，他妹妹周晓曼担心他错失傍上豪门的机会，竟然让人绑了她，想把她送给合作商，用来断周治学的念头。
en: But Zhixue Zhou simply would not let go. His sister, Xiaoman Zhou, feared he would miss the chance to attach himself to a wealthy family, and actually had her tied up, wanting to hand her over to a business partner, so as to make Zhixue Zhou abandon the idea.

text: 如果不是她撑着一口气跑出房间，又恰好遇上祁深。
en: If she had not, with one last breath, run out of the room and happened to meet Shen Qi.

text: 恐怕不仅要被那个臭名昭著的刘总羞辱，还得被拍上一组大片，出尽风头！
en: She would probably not only have been humiliated by that notorious Manager Liu, but also have had a whole photo set taken of her, making a complete spectacle of herself!

text: 她没有回答祁深，好一会儿才轻声道：“祁教授，谢谢您。
en: She did not answer Shen Qi, and only after a long while said softly: “Professor Qi, thank you.

text: 谢？
en: Thank me?

text: 祁深漆黑眸底闪过一丝兴味。
en: A flicker of interest passed through the depths of Shen Qi's dark eyes.

text: 他点了下头，“举手之劳。
en: He nodded. “A mere small favour.

text: 不知为何，时思遥觉得他话里有话。
en: For some reason, Siyao Shi felt there was more to his words.

text: 脸已经丢尽了，她干脆咬牙埋头继续整理自己，快速弄好后，她依旧不敢看他。
en: Her dignity already lost, she simply gritted her teeth and lowered her head to continue sorting herself out; once quickly done, she still dared not look at him.

text: “今晚的事，能麻烦您当没发生过吗？
en: “About tonight's events, could I trouble you to act as if they never happened?

text: 祁深掀了掀眼皮，往她脸上看了一眼。
en: Shen Qi lifted his eyelids and glanced at her face.

text: 原来是要跟他划清关系。
en: So she wanted to draw a clear line between them.

text: 他觉得有些好笑，难道他还会缠着她？
en: He found it rather amusing—would he really cling to her?

text: 他自问不是纵欲的人，今晚这一出意外，也只是因为得知苏栩结婚，让他理智有些崩盘。
en: He asked himself whether he was a man given to indulgence; tonight's accident was only because learning of Xu Su's marriage had made his reason somewhat collapse.

text: 再加上…
en: Added to that…

text: 他视线勾勒过时思遥的小脸，被汗水沾湿的酡红尚未完全褪去，一双眼睛却清可见底。
en: His gaze traced Siyao Shi's small face; the flushed red, damp with sweat, had not yet fully faded, yet her pair of eyes were clear to the bottom.

text: “收拾好了，我送你回去。
en: “All sorted? I'll take you home.

text: 他这么说，应该就是答应了。
en: Saying that, he had probably agreed.

text: 时思遥松了口气。
en: Siyao Shi breathed a sigh of relief.

text: 车一路开向她住的公寓，下车前，祁深拿了张名片给她。
en: The car drove all the way to her apartment; before she got out, Shen Qi handed her a business card.

text: 烫金的，很精致。

text: 祁深说：“有事可以给我打电话。

text: 黑色的车缓缓驶进了夜色中，彻底消失不见。
en: The black car slowly drove into the night and disappeared completely.

text: 一天的惊吓波折，时思遥此刻身心俱疲，难受得紧，走到楼下都耗了半天。
en: After a day of fright and turmoil, Siyao Shi was now utterly exhausted in body and mind, feeling wretched, and it took her ages just to walk downstairs.

text: 刚要上楼，一旁停着的警车上却下来了人。
en: Just as she was about to go upstairs, someone got out of a police car parked to the side.

text: “请问是时思遥女士吗？
en: “Excuse me, are you Ms Siyao Shi?

text: 时思遥一愣，心中有些不祥的预感。
en: Siyao Shi froze for a moment, a vague premonition of doom rising in her heart.

text: 警察出示了证件，口吻公式化：“请你跟我们走一趟，有位周先生报警，指控你挪用公款。
en: The police officer showed his credentials and said in a formulaic tone: “Please come with us. A Mr Zhou has reported you, accusing you of embezzling public funds.

text: 时思遥在警局呆了三个小时，才被暂时放出来。
en: Siyao Shi stayed at the police station for three hours before being temporarily released.

text: 她拖着一身疲惫回家，刚坐下就接到了周治学的电话。
en: She dragged her weary self home, and had just sat down when she received a call from Zhixue Zhou.

text: 她恨得咬牙，快速接通了。
en: She answered quickly, gnashing her teeth with hatred.

text: “周治学，我们已经分手了，你非要毁了我吗？

en: That four million in funds—he personally called and instructed her to transfer it!

text: 周治学料到了她的愤怒，他平静道：“遥遥，你不该跟我提分手的。

en: Wait for me three years, and three years from now I will surely divorce and marry you.

text: 时思遥听着想笑，“那这三年你打算怎么安置我？
en: Siyao Shi felt like laughing as she listened. “Then how do you plan to settle me during these three years?

text: “我会送你出国留学。
en: “I will send you abroad to study.

text: 无耻！
en: Shameless!

en: On one hand he wants to marry the rich heiress, on the other he uses the rich family's money to keep her as his 'mistress'!

en: Siyao Shi gave a cold laugh and said: “But I've already slept with someone else.

text: 对面停顿两秒，声音沉了下来，周治学根本不信。
en: There was a two-second pause on the other end, the voice sank, and Zhixue Zhou simply did not believe it.

text: “别跟我开这种玩笑，惹怒我，对你没有好处。
en: “Don't joke with me like that; if you anger me, it won't do you any good.

text: 时思遥深呼吸，咬牙问：“你到底想怎么样？
en: Siyao Shi took a deep breath and asked through gritted teeth: “What on earth do you want?

en: “You're dreaming!

en: Zhixue Zhou was very calm and reminded her: “Yaoyao, if I don't withdraw the case, the only way for you to prove your innocence is to trace where the funds went.

text: 你进去了，谁照顾外婆？
en: If you go in, who will look after your grandmother?

text: 时思遥如果有力气，早就对着电话破口大骂了！
en: If Siyao Shi had had the energy, she would have already unleashed a torrent of abuse down the phone!

text: 她当初真是瞎了眼了。
en: She must have been blind back then.

text: “我等你来找我。
en: “I'll wait for you to come to me.

text: 周治学说话，挂了电话。
en: Zhixue Zhou finished speaking and hung up.

text: 时思遥疲惫不堪。
en: Siyao Shi was utterly exhausted.

text: 手机还在震动。
en: Her phone was still vibrating.

en: “You didn't accompany Manager Liu?

en: “If you dare tell my brother about tonight, you're dead.

en: “Which wild man did you run off with?

text: 时思遥觉得恶心，直接把她拉黑了。
en: Siyao Shi felt sickened and directly blocked her.

text: 祁深太能折腾，时思遥第二天起来都觉得不舒服。
en: Shen Qi was too much to handle; the next day Siyao Shi still felt unwell when she got up.
