en: But she could not rest. Her classmate Lu Jiang had pulled some strings for her—also an alumnus of theirs, a man named Guoming Zou, whose father is said to hold a high position in the judicial world. She was counting on him to smooth things over so she could trace the funds as soon as possible.

text: 餐厅里，时思遥陪着已经坐了一个多小时。
en: In the restaurant, Siyao Shi had already been sitting with him for over an hour.

text: 期间，邹国明一直不谈正事，拉着她说那些她根本没印象的校园回忆，时思遥心里不适，也只能忍着，挑时间说正题。
en: During this time, Guoming Zou kept off the real business, instead dragging her into campus memories she had no impression of at all. Siyao Shi felt uneasy but could only bear it, waiting for the right moment to raise the main topic.

text: 正心急如焚的时候，视线一抬，瞥见迎面而来的男人。
en: Just as she was burning with anxiety, she looked up and caught sight of a man coming towards her.

text: 祁深一身黑色西装，手里拿着外套，气质斯文得体，那张脸实在太好看，五官深邃，却不显得凌厉逼人，天然有种高高在上的清贵感。
en: Shen Qi was in a black suit, holding his jacket, his bearing refined and poised. That face was truly too handsome—his features deep-set, yet not sharply intimidating, with a natural, aloof air of noble elegance.

text: 身后跟着几个助手，身边是侃侃而谈的精英男，显然有饭局。
en: Behind him followed a few assistants, and beside him was a talkative elite man; clearly he had a dinner engagement.

text: 时思遥想起昨夜彼此在车里的交集，心跳陡然加快，本想低头，祁深却好像已经看到她了，迎着他的目光，她只好硬着头皮点头示意。
en: Siyao Shi recalled last night's encounter in the car, and her heartbeat suddenly quickened. She had meant to lower her head, but Shen Qi seemed to have already seen her; meeting his gaze, she could only steel herself and nod in acknowledgement.

text: 祁深没回应她，被众人簇拥着径直走向了全场最佳的靠窗位置，且还有四面屏风，私密性极好。
en: Shen Qi did not respond to her; surrounded by the crowd, he walked straight to the best window-side seat in the whole place, which also had screens on four sides, offering excellent privacy.

text: 确定他看不见她，她才松口气。
en: Only when certain he could not see her did she breathe a sigh of relief.

text: 窗边，祁深落座。
en: By the window, Shen Qi took his seat.

text: 众人都捧着他，他态度却只算得上礼貌，视线偶然间从屏风间隙看向了外面。
en: Everyone fawned over him, yet his attitude was merely polite; his gaze occasionally drifted outward through the gap in the screens.

text: 昨夜匆匆纠缠，今天才在灯光下看清。
en: Last night's hurried intimacy—only today, in the light, could he see her clearly.

text: 她穿了一身旗袍，月白色的缎面，巧妙勾勒出纤秾合度的身形，被绾起的长发只用了一根发簪。
en: She wore a qipao of moon-white satin, which cleverly outlined a figure of just the right fullness and slenderness; her pinned-up long hair was held by a single hairpin.

text: 本就精致立体的五官，带着江南烟雨的朦胧感，很是温婉动人。
en: Her already delicate, defined features carried the hazy quality of Jiangnan's misty rain, gentle and captivating.

text: 对面坐着的男子长相一般，正眉飞色舞地吹嘘着，几次试图靠近。
en: The man sitting opposite, of ordinary looks, was boasting with animated delight, several times trying to move closer.

text: 祁深只看了一眼，便收回视线。
en: Shen Qi took only one glance and withdrew his gaze.

text: 外间，邹国明铺垫了半天，终于发现时思遥的脸有些红了。
en: In the outer area, Guoming Zou had been laying the groundwork for ages, and finally noticed that Siyao Shi's face had flushed a little.

text: 他觉得时机不错了，就把手放在了时思遥手背上。
en: Thinking the moment was right, he placed his hand on the back of Siyao Shi's hand.

text: 时思遥一惊，抽回手，“你干什么？
en: Siyao Shi started in alarm and pulled her hand back. “What are you doing?

text: “遥遥，做我女朋友吧？
en: “Yaoyao, be my girlfriend?

text: 我知道你有事求我，你放心，你的事我一定给你办好。
en: I know you have something to ask of me; rest assured, I will certainly take care of your matter.

text: 邹国明说着，还要伸手来拉她。
en: As Guoming Zou spoke, he reached out again to pull her.

text: 时思遥气急，“抱歉，我想你误会了，我不是来跟你相亲的。
en: Siyao Shi was furious. “I'm sorry, I think you've misunderstood; I'm not here to meet you for a match.

text: 她拿起包就打算走，“账我结过了，你慢用…
en: She picked up her bag and meant to leave. “I've paid the bill; take your time…

text: 邹国明拦住她，有些不敢置信。
en: Guoming Zou blocked her, somewhat unable to believe it.

text: “时思遥！
en: “Siyao Shi!

text: 你敢拒绝我？
en: You dare reject me?

text: 周围不少人都看了过来，时思遥越发尴尬。
en: Many people around looked over, and Siyao Shi grew even more embarrassed.

text: 想让邹国明小声点，不料，邹国明却十分气愤。
en: Wanting Guoming Zou to lower his voice, contrary to her wish, Guoming Zou became quite furious.

text: “装什么贞洁烈女！
en: “What chaste martyr are you playing at!

text: 还以为自己是当年经管系的系花呢！
en: You still think you're the belle of the Economics and Management department from those years!

text: 你让周治学玩了三年，还被他甩了，不嫌弃你就不错了！
en: You let Zhixue Zhou toy with you for three years and then got dumped by him—it's already generous of him not to despise you!

text: 时思遥脸色煞白。
en: Siyao Shi's face went deathly pale.

text: 她不想再纠缠，试图从另一侧绕开他。
en: She did not want to entangle further and tried to get around him from the other side.

text: 两人动作太大，牵扯到桌布，边沿的菜盘掀翻，整个倒在了旗袍上。
en: Their movements were too big, catching the tablecloth, and the dishes at the edge were knocked over, spilling entirely onto her qipao.

text: 服务员也被吸引过来了。
en: The waiter was also drawn over.

text: 邹国明还不想让步，一把将时思遥抓住。
en: Guoming Zou still would not back down and grabbed Siyao Shi.

text: 时思遥奋力挣脱，脚下却一个踉跄，往后退了好几步。
en: Siyao Shi struggled free, but stumbled, lurching backward several steps.

text: 直到后背撞上一堵胸膛堪堪才稳住。
en: Until her back struck a chest, and only then did she steady herself.

text: 男人扶住了她的身体，力道适中。
en: The man steadied her body with measured strength.

text: 经理匆匆赶到，见祁深在场，二话不说就站在时思遥这边，让人请邹国明出去。
en: The manager hurried over; seeing Shen Qi present, he took Siyao Shi's side without a word and had someone escort Guoming Zou out.

text: 邹国明还在嚷嚷。
en: Guoming Zou was still shouting.

text: 时思遥只觉丢人，尤其还是在祁深面前。
en: Siyao Shi only felt humiliated, especially in front of Shen Qi.

text: 祁深轻拍了下她的手臂。
en: Shen Qi gave her arm a light pat.

text: 男人淡淡道：“先上楼，把衣服换了。
en: The man said flatly: “Go upstairs first and change your clothes.

text: 本想拒绝，话到嘴边，见周围人还在看，时思遥只能点头，跟着他离开。
en: She had meant to refuse, the words at her lips, but seeing people still watching, Siyao Shi could only nod and follow him away.

text: 餐厅楼上就是本市数一数二的五星级酒店，祁深在这里显然有固定的房间。
en: Upstairs from the restaurant was one of the city's top five-star hotels; Shen Qi clearly had a fixed room here.

text: 前一晚才发生过那样的关系，此刻跟着他上楼，时思遥心里咚咚地跳。
en: Having had that kind of relationship just the night before, following him upstairs now made Siyao Shi's heart pound.

text: 进了套房，她脚步迟疑。
en: Entering the suite, she hesitated in her steps.

text: 祁深站在客厅里，往她的方向看过来。
en: Shen Qi stood in the living room, looking in her direction.

text: 他的目光平静幽深，片刻后才说：“里面有浴室，你可以随便用。
en: His gaze was calm and deep; after a moment he said: “There's a bathroom inside; feel free to use it.

text: 身上滑腻腻的，大概是倒在衣服上的汤汁浸透了布料。
en: Her body felt greasy—probably the soup that had spilled on her clothes had soaked through the fabric.

text: 站在华丽精致的地毯上，时思遥都觉得是玷污了地毯，更何况，祁深还看着她。
en: Standing on the magnificent, exquisite carpet, Siyao Shi felt she was defiling it—and what's more, Shen Qi was still looking at her.

text: 她慌乱地点了下头，踩着高跟鞋进了浴室。
en: She nodded in a fluster and, in her high heels, entered the bathroom.

text: 关上门，避开那道难以忽略的视线，不由松了口气。
en: Closing the door and avoiding that impossible-to-ignore gaze, she could not help but breathe a sigh of relief.

text: 可下一秒，她看着镜子里的自己，僵在了原地。
en: But the next second, looking at herself in the mirror, she froze on the spot.

text: 原本雅致的旗袍，上半身还完好无损，下半部分已经被汤汁彻底浸润的浅色布料，印出无比清晰的轮廓…
en: The originally elegant qipao, its upper half still intact, but its lower half—light-coloured fabric thoroughly soaked by the soup—revealed an all-too-clear outline…

text: 时思遥后知后觉回想起方才祁深的眼神，快速从镜子前离开，把脏掉的衣服脱下往里去。
en: Siyao Shi realised only afterwards, recalling Shen Qi's gaze just now; she quickly left the mirror and took off the soiled clothes, heading inward.

text: 洗完后，她才想起没有可换洗的衣物在这里。
en: After washing, she remembered there were no change of clothes here.

text: 浴室里，只有件男士浴袍。
en: In the bathroom, there was only a men's bathrobe.

text: 时思遥想起昨晚祁深的态度，不像是趁人之危的小人，说不定已经不在外面了。
en: Siyao Shi recalled Shen Qi's attitude last night; he did not seem the sort to take advantage of someone in trouble, and might already have left the outer room.

text: 这么想着，她套上浴袍，拉开门前，还试探着叫了一声：“祁教授？
en: Thinking this, she slipped on the bathrobe, and before pulling the door open, tentatively called out: “Professor Qi?

text: 没人回应。
en: No one answered.

text: 她松了口气，快速出门，想叫前台帮忙买套衣服。
en: She breathed a sigh of relief, quickly left the room, and wanted to ask the front desk to help buy a set of clothes.

text: 坐在床边，刚拿起酒店座机，手机开始疯狂震动。
en: Sitting on the bed's edge, just as she picked up the hotel landline, her mobile phone began to vibrate frantically.

text: 拿起一看，是蒋露发给她的截图。
en: She picked it up and saw it was a screenshot Lu Jiang had sent her.

text: “遥遥，怎么回事，你不是求邹国明帮忙吗？
en: “Yaoyao, what's going on? Weren't you asking Guoming Zou for help?

text: 怎么闹翻了？
en: How did you fall out?

text: “那傻逼在群里内涵你，说你被包了！
en: “That arsehole is implying things about you in the group chat, saying you've been kept!

text: 时思遥点开班级群一看，果然是。
en: Siyao Shi opened the class group chat and, sure enough, it was.

text: 邹国明说的有鼻子有眼，还有一堆人在后面安慰他。
en: Guoming Zou's account was vivid and detailed, and a bunch of people were comforting him in the replies.

text: “像她那种被玩烂的，老子根本看不上眼，还想白嫖老子，求老子办事，呸！
en: “Someone like her, used and ruined, I wouldn't give a damn about—yet she wants to freeload off me and beg me for favours. Pah!

text: 这半个月来，时思遥已经够倒霉了，没人帮她不说，现在还要看群里各种阴阳。
en: Over these past half-month, Siyao Shi had already been unlucky enough; not only did no one help her, now she also had to read all sorts of passive-aggressive digs in the group.

text: 她一时间气得脸色发白，又委屈地红了眼睛。
en: For a moment she was so angry her face went white, and then, aggrieved, her eyes reddened.

text: “衣服等下有人会送来。
en: “Clothes will be sent up shortly.

text: 一道清润的男声从旁边传来。
en: A clear, gentle male voice came from beside her.

text: 时思遥吓了一跳，抬眸看去，这才发现，祁深就坐在对面的沙发上。
en: Siyao Shi started in surprise; she looked up and only then realised Shen Qi was sitting on the sofa opposite.

text: 他！
en: Him!

text: 他怎么不出声呢！
en: Why didn't he make a sound!

text: 时思遥下意识绷紧了身体。
en: Siyao Shi instinctively tensed her body.

text: 她里面什么都没穿。
en: She had nothing on underneath.

text: 祁深似乎看出她的想法，他不疾不徐道：“我应了，你没听见。
en: Shen Qi seemed to see her thought; he said unhurriedly: “I answered; you didn't hear.

text: 弦外之音，不怪我。
en: The implication being: don't blame me.

text: 时思遥语塞。
en: Siyao Shi was speechless.

text: 她下意识站了起来。
en: She instinctively stood up.

text: 脚踝迟钝地传来痛意，她轻呼一声，又跌坐回了床上。
en: A dull pain came from her ankle; she gave a soft cry and fell back down onto the bed.

text: 祁深视线下移落在了她的脚上，隔得远，他只能评价一句小巧，可怜地并拢在一起，脚趾都蜷紧了。
en: Shen Qi's gaze dropped to her feet; from a distance he could only note that they were small and delicate, pitifully pressed together, the toes curled tight.

text: 时思遥只觉自己倒霉，细想一下，可能是往后跌那一下就伤了，上楼时一路紧张，都没觉得疼，不知道是不是泡了热水的缘故，这会儿已肿得老高。
en: Siyao Shi only felt her own misfortune; thinking carefully, she might have been injured in that backward fall, but going upstairs she was so nervous she felt no pain, and whether it was from soaking in hot water or not, by now it had swollen badly.

text: 祁深打了通电话，“买点跌打损伤的药送上来。
en: Shen Qi made a phone call. “Buy some medicine for bruises and sprains and send it up.

text: 时思遥张了张口。
en: Siyao Shi opened her mouth.

text: 祁深已经丢下了手机，“等着。
en: Shen Qi had already put down the phone. “Wait.

text: 她只好闭嘴了。
en: She could only shut up.

text: 没多久，药就送了上来，祁深亲自去取来，放在了时思遥身边。
en: Before long the medicine was sent up; Shen Qi went to fetch it himself and placed it by Siyao Shi's side.

text: 幸而，他没在她身边停留太久。
en: Fortunately, he did not linger by her side too long.

text: 时思遥在心里默数，希望送衣服的侍应生赶紧到。
en: Siyao Shi counted silently in her heart, hoping the waiter delivering clothes would hurry up.

text: 为免尴尬，她开了药，也好有点事做。
en: To avoid awkwardness, she opened the medicine, so as to have something to do.

text: 正安静，祁深忽然放下手里杂志，身子后靠，目光打量地看她。
en: Just as it was quiet, Shen Qi suddenly put down the magazine in his hand, leaned back, and looked at her with an assessing gaze.

text: “刚才怎么回事？
en: “What happened just now?

text: 时思遥扯了下嘴角，垂眸道：“我被人陷害挪用公款，想找人帮忙疏通下关系。
en: Siyao Shi tugged at the corner of her mouth, lowered her eyes and said: “I was framed for embezzling public funds, and wanted to find someone to help smooth things over.

text: 那人是我大学同学，他爸爸是法院的院长。
en: That person is a university classmate of mine; his father is the president of the court.

text: “你那同学叫什么？
en: “What is your classmate's name?

text: “邹国明。
en: “Guoming Zou.

text: 祁深淡淡道：“据我所知，金陵法院的几个院长里，并没有姓邹的。
en: Shen Qi said flatly: “As far as I know, among the several presidents of the Jinling court, none is surnamed Zou.

text: 时思遥愣住。
en: Siyao Shi was stunned.

text: 没有姓邹的？
en: None surnamed Zou?

text: 那…
en: Then…

text: 她忽然反应过来，被骗了！
en: She suddenly realised—she had been deceived!

text: 邹国明十有八九是吹牛的！
en: Guoming Zou was most likely bragging!

text: 她懊悔不迭，自己病急乱投医，太蠢了。
en: She was filled with regret; in her desperation she had clutched at any straw—too foolish.

text: 祁深问：“男朋友怎么不帮你？
en: Shen Qi asked: “Why isn't your boyfriend helping you?

text: 时思遥咬唇：“已经分手了，就是他陷害了我。
en: Siyao Shi bit her lip. “We've already broken up; he is the one who framed me.

text: 祁深眸中闪过诧异。
en: A flicker of surprise passed through Shen Qi's eyes.

text: 随即，他点了下头，“你的经历比我想象中更精彩。
en: Then he nodded. “Your experience is more colourful than I imagined.

text: 时思遥觉得他这话有几分戏谑的意思，她低下头，避开他的视线，轻轻往脚上抹药。
en: Siyao Shi felt there was a hint of teasing in his words; she lowered her head, avoiding his gaze, and gently applied the medicine to her foot.

text: 走神之际，忽然听到脚步声。
en: As she lost herself in thought, she suddenly heard footsteps.

text: 一抬头，发现祁深已经到了她面前。
en: Looking up, she found Shen Qi already before her.

text: 她下意识拢紧了浴袍，身子直起，往后靠去，企图拉开适当的距离。
en: She instinctively gathered the bathrobe tight, straightened up, and leaned back, trying to create a proper distance.

text: 靠得近，祁深清晰地看到她垂眸间睫毛颤动，十分怕他的样子。
en: Up close, Shen Qi clearly saw her eyelashes tremble as she lowered her eyes, looking very much afraid of him.

text: 视线往下，落在她的脚上，脚踝处粉粉的，不知是天生的，还是受伤所致。
en: His gaze moved down to her feet; the ankles were pinkish—whether naturally so or from the injury, he could not tell.

text: “跌打损伤的药需要揉按才有效，你这么涂一百遍，也是浪费。
en: “Medicine for bruises and sprains only works if you rub it in; applying it like that a hundred times is a waste.

text: 时思遥愣了下。
en: Siyao Shi was taken aback for a moment.

text: 话未出口，男人在她面前半蹲身子。
en: Before the words left her mouth, the man half-knelt before her.

text: 她惊了下，下意识往后缩脚，却被他很自然地握住了她的脚踝。
en: She started, instinctively drawing her foot back, but he very naturally took hold of her ankle.

text: 时思遥听到自己咚咚的心跳声，她不知道祁深是什么意思，亲自给她涂药，已经有点逾矩了。
en: Siyao Shi heard her own pounding heartbeat; she did not know what Shen Qi meant—applying the medicine for her himself was already somewhat beyond propriety.

text: 她双手压在身侧，一动不敢动。
en: Her hands pressed at her sides, she dared not move a muscle.

text: 祁深似乎只是为了给她涂药，其余的，丝毫没做。
en: Shen Qi seemed only to be applying medicine for her; beyond that, he did absolutely nothing.

text: 他的动作不轻不重，好几次弄疼她。
en: His touch was neither light nor heavy, and several times it hurt her.
“It hurts!

text: 她喊了一次，他抬眸看她，漆黑的眼瞳里深不见底。
en: She cried out once; he looked up at her, the depths of his dark pupils unfathomable.

text: “我轻一点。
en: “I'll be gentler.

text: 她咬紧唇瓣，呼吸更加紧绷。
en: She bit her lip tightly, her breathing even more taut.

text: 祁深继续给她擦药，忽然，貌似不经意地问：“跟男朋友恋爱几年了？
en: Shen Qi continued to rub in the medicine, then suddenly, seemingly casually, asked: “How many years were you with your boyfriend?

text: “三年…
en: “Three years…

text: 男人手指顿了顿，“三年了，没同居过？
en: The man's fingers paused. “Three years, and you never lived together?

text: 时思遥愣住。
en: Siyao Shi was stunned.

text: 她反应了下他的问题，随即才明白过来。
en: She paused over his question for a moment before she understood.

text: 她昨晚是什么情况，他知道的。
en: He knew what had happened to her the previous night.

text: 这个问题翻译过来是：怎么没跟男朋友做过。
en: Translated, the question meant: why haven't you done it with your boyfriend.

text: 她脸上涨红，半天没挤出声音。
en: Her face flushed red, and for a long while she could not force out a sound.

text: 在男女之事上，她只有过祁深一个，周治学在出轨前，对她做过最大尺度的事，就是亲吻拥抱，他们始终没到最后一步。
en: In matters between men and women, Qi Shen was the only one she had ever been with; before Zhou Zhixue's affair, the most intimate thing he had done with her was kissing and embracing, and they had never gone all the way.

text: 她毫无经验，谈到这些事，只觉得越发尴尬。
en: She had no experience at all, and speaking of such things only made her more embarrassed.

text: 祁深又抬头看她。
en: Qi Shen looked up at her again.

text: 她才勉强说：“不太习惯，想等到结婚。
en: She managed to say, “I'm not quite used to it; I wanted to wait until marriage.

text: 这是真话。
en: That was the truth.

text: 祁深看着她的脸，知道她没撒谎。
en: Qi Shen looked at her face and knew she was not lying.

text: 那双眼睛太干净了。
en: Those eyes were too pure.

text: “你是个乖女孩儿。
en: “You are a good girl.

text: ”他淡淡道。
en: ”he said flatly.

text: 时思遥咬紧了唇瓣。
en: Siyao Shi bit her lips tightly.

text: 她想起刚才群里对她的议论，还有最近遭受到的不公对待，听到他这么说，她忽然就有些委屈。
en: She thought of the gossip about her in the group chat just now, and the unfair treatment she had suffered lately; hearing him say this, she suddenly felt a little aggrieved.

text: 她明明什么都没有做错，结果谁都要来踩她一脚。
en: She had clearly done nothing wrong, yet everyone seemed bent on trampling her down.

text: 祁深只是随口一说，涂完了药，他径直起身。
en: Qi Shen had only spoken offhandedly; having finished applying the medicine, he rose straight to his feet.

text: 时思遥赶紧往后退了些，挪动间，牵动腿心，微微的刺痛传了过来。
en: Siyao Shi hurriedly drew back a little; as she moved, it tugged at the tender place between her legs, and a faint stinging pain came through.

text: 昨夜的肿还没有消。
en: The swelling from the night before had not yet gone down.

text: 祁深平静的视线透过镜片，敏锐地发现她并拢双腿的不自然动作。
en: Qi Shen's calm gaze, through his lenses, keenly caught the unnatural way she kept her legs pressed together.

text: “腿上也有伤？
en: “Are there injuries on your legs as well?

text: 闻言，时思遥浑身都在发烫，她下意识抬眸，摇头。
en: At this, Siyao Shi felt her whole body burn; she looked up instinctively and shook her head.

text: “没有！
en: “No!

text: 女孩眼睛红红的，鼻头也有点红，巴掌大的脸上，满是苍白脆弱，活像一朵风雨中被欺负过的玫瑰朵儿。
en: The girl's eyes were red, the tip of her nose a little red too; on a face no bigger than a palm, she was pale and fragile, exactly like a rose that had been bullied by wind and rain.

text: 祁深逼近了一步。
en: Qi Shen took a step closer.

text: 她又往后退。
en: She stepped back again.

text: “时思遥。
en: “Siyao Shi.

text: ”他叫了声她的名字。
en: ”he called her name.

text: 她瞬间就抓紧了身后的床单。
en: In an instant she clutched the bedsheet behind her.

text: 祁深视线攫住她的脸，唇瓣掀动：“我昨晚弄伤你了，是不是。
en: Qi Shen's gaze seized her face, his lips moved: “I hurt you last night, didn't I.

text: 那么私密的事被他大剌剌地说出来，时思遥头皮一麻，她仰着头，有点不知所措地看着他。
en: That such an intimate matter should be said so brazenly by him made Siyao Shi's scalp tingle; she tilted her head up and looked at him, at a loss.

text: 见她不言语，祁深从药箱里翻出一管药膏，扫了两眼注意事项。
en: Seeing she would not speak, Qi Shen fished a tube of ointment from the medicine box and glanced over the precautions.

text: 他重新看向她，波澜不惊地说：“我看看。
en: He looked at her again and said, without the slightest ripple, “Let me have a look.

text: 明明是温和的语气，却带着几分不容抗拒。
en: It was a gentle tone, yet carried a note of something not to be refused.

text: 时思遥瞪大眼睛。
en: Siyao Shi widened her eyes.

text: 她咬紧唇瓣，怀疑自己听错了。
en: She bit her lips, suspecting she had misheard.

text: 如果方才祁深的出格举动，让她只是产生暧昧的错觉，此刻祁深的话，就让她不再怀疑。
en: If Qi Shen's inappropriate move just now had only given her an ambiguous illusion, then his words at this moment left her in no doubt.

text: 他对她有意。
en: He was interested in her.

text: 或者说，不排斥和她发生关系。
en: Or rather, he did not reject the idea of being intimate with her.

text: 她一时间有点混乱，还没反应过来，祁深一个俯身，将她从床沿抱了起来，在她的惊呼声中，把她放在了大班台的边沿。
en: She was thrown into a brief confusion and had not yet collected herself when Qi Shen bent down, lifted her from the edge of the bed, and, amid her cry of alarm, set her down on the edge of the executive desk.

text: 面前是男人不可撼动的高大身影，时思遥下意识往后退。
en: Before her was the man's immovable, towering figure; Siyao Shi instinctively drew back.

text: 祁深上前一步，刚好把她卡在那个位置。
en: Qi Shen stepped forward, pinning her exactly in that spot.

text: “教授…
en: “Professor…

text: 时思遥几乎要哭了。
en: Siyao Shi was almost in tears.

text: 她伸手推拒他的动作，却没怎么敢用力。
en: She reached out to push him away, yet did not dare use much force.

text: 祁深似乎有所预料，他有条不紊地拆着药膏，狡猾地问她：“没了同学帮忙，接下来打算怎么办？
en: Qi Shen seemed to have expected this; as he methodically unwrapped the ointment, he asked her slyly, “With your classmates no longer helping you, what do you plan to do next?

text: 时思遥看着他，目光颤动。
en: Siyao Shi looked at him, her gaze trembling.

text: 她不知道，他是不是在暗示她，可以求他帮忙。
en: She did not know whether he was hinting that she could ask him for help.

text: 但她的确起过这样的念头，以祁深的权势地位，想要解决周治学十分容易。
en: But she had indeed entertained such a thought; given Qi Shen's power and standing, dealing with Zhou Zhixue would be all too easy.

text: 她脑袋很混乱，没再挣扎。
en: Her mind was in a muddle, and she stopped struggling.

text: 祁深已经推高了浴袍下摆。
en: Qi Shen had already pushed up the hem of her bathrobe.

text: 骨节分明的修长手指沾了药膏，冰冰凉的。
en: His long, well-defined fingers, smeared with ointment, were cool to the touch.

text: 时思遥浑身都绷紧了，原本推拒他身体的手，慢慢抓紧了他的衬衫，一点点收紧，指甲泛起白色。
en: Siyao Shi went rigid all over; the hands that had been pushing him away slowly gripped his shirt, tightening bit by bit until her nails turned white.

text: 她没忍住出声。
en: She could not hold back a sound.

text: 祁深收了手。
en: Qi Shen withdrew his hand.

text: 他还站在她身前，只是顺手抽了湿巾擦拭手指。
en: He still stood before her, merely drawing a wet wipe to clean his fingers.

text: 时思遥眼睛紧闭，等着他退开，然而迟迟没有等到。
en: Siyao Shi shut her eyes tight, waiting for him to step away, yet he did not.

text: 她有些疑惑，下意识抬头。
en: A little puzzled, she looked up instinctively.

text: 唇瓣擦过触感，男人温热的气息撒在她的侧脸上。
en: Her lips brushed against something; the man's warm breath fell across her cheek.

text: 她吻到了他的嘴角。
en: She had kissed the corner of his mouth.

text: 祁深没有避开，但也没有下一步动作。
en: Qi Shen did not avoid it, but made no further move either.

text: 时思遥脑中天人交战，要么求祁深，或许只要这么一次，要么送去给周治学羞辱，跟他纠缠不清。
en: Inside Siyao Shi's mind a battle raged: either ask Qi Shen for help—perhaps just this once—or be handed over to Zhou Zhixue for humiliation and entangled with him endlessly.

text: 最终，还是理智占据上风。
en: In the end, reason won out.

text: 她做出了反应，先是小心地攀上祁深的肩膀，然后寻到他的唇瓣，试探性轻触。
en: She reacted: first she cautiously climbed onto Qi Shen's shoulders, then found his lips and touched them with a tentative, light press.

text: 祁深没立即回应她。
en: Qi Shen did not respond to her at once.

text: 她什么心思，他一清二楚，不过他不介意。
en: He saw through her thoughts perfectly well, but he did not mind.

text: 男欢女爱，年长者付出适当的代价是应该的，又不是恋爱结婚，需要彼此心意坦诚。
en: Pleasure between a man and a woman—it is only right that the older party pays a fitting price; it is not as though they were in love and marrying, where hearts must be laid bare.

text: 他很好奇的是，她能做到什么地步。
en: What he was curious about was how far she could go.

text: 然而事实证明，她青涩得毫无经验。
en: Yet it turned out she was as green as could be, with no experience at all.

text: 只是蜻蜓点水地吻着他，艰难地伸出舌头在他唇上扫过，就已经紧张得呼吸紊乱。
en: She only brushed his lips like a dragonfly skimming water, and merely managed with difficulty to extend her tongue and sweep it across his lips, yet she was already so nervous her breathing grew ragged.

text: 见他没有反应，她脸上涨红得快要滴血，难堪得往后退开。
en: Seeing he gave no response, her face flushed crimson, as if blood might drip from it; mortified, she drew back.

text: 他不免失笑。
en: He could not help but laugh.

text: 够娇气的。
en: Quite the delicate little thing.

text: 时思遥觉得太丢人了，或许，是她会错意了，祁深根本没那个意思。
en: Siyao Shi felt utterly humiliated; perhaps she had misread him, and Qi Shen had meant nothing of the sort.

text: 然而，她刚退开，男人却骤然伸手，手臂将她捞了回去，口吻戏谑：“就只会这么点？
en: Yet the moment she pulled back, the man suddenly reached out, his arm hooking her back, and said mockingly, “Is that all you've got?

text: 时思遥微愣，抬头看他，陡然撞进他幽深黑亮的眸底。
en: Siyao Shi faltered, looked up at him, and suddenly met the depths of his dark, lustrous eyes.

text: 她的心跟着一缩。
en: Her heart clenched in response.

text: 祁深手顺势绕过她后颈，带着她靠近自己，绅士的伪装卸下一角，像是不容抗拒的疾风骤雨，强势地吻了下来！
en: Qi Shen's hand slid around the back of her neck, drawing her close; the gentleman's disguise slipped a little, and like an irresistible storm he kissed her firmly, dominatingly!

text: 时思遥躺在那有些不知所措。
en: Siyao Shi lay there, somewhat at a loss.

text: 祁深单手撑在她脸侧，俯身品尝她半唇甘甜的同时，拉开了浴袍的细带。
en: Qi Shen braced one hand beside her face, and as he leaned down to taste the sweetness of her lips, he loosened the thin sash of her bathrobe.

text: 掌心的温热，终于毫无阻拦地贴上她的细腰，寸寸往上。
en: The warmth of his palm finally met her slender waist without hindrance, moving upward inch by inch.

text: 隔着屏风，看着她的背影时，他就想这么做了。
en: He had wanted to do this ever since, through the screen, he had watched her from behind.

text: 可惜，那时候她在对那邹国明假笑。
en: It was a pity that, back then, she had been flashing that false smile at Guoming Zou.

text: 脖颈被男人吮着，身体在他掌控下，颤栗感涌遍全身，时思遥听到男人逐渐加重的呼吸和力道，还有他伸手解扣子时的细微动静，她脸色涨红，别过了脸。
en: Her neck sucked by the man, her body under his control, a shiver ran through her whole body; Siyao Shi heard the man's breathing and force gradually intensify, and the faint sounds as he reached to undo his buttons; her face flushed red and she turned it away.

text: 昏暗灯光下，有金属熠熠生辉。
en: In the dim light, something metallic glinted brilliantly.

text: 她撑开濡湿的眸子，视线聚焦，看清楚了发光的事物。
en: She forced open her damp eyes, focused her gaze, and made out the gleaming object.

text: 是祁深手上的戒指。
en: It was the ring on Qi Shen's hand.

text: 戴在无名指上。
en: Worn on his ring finger.

text: 刹那间，浑身的燥热仿佛都被一盆凉水浇灭了。
en: In that instant, the heat all over her body seemed doused by a basin of cold water.

text: 她算了下祁深的年纪，大概快三十了。
en: She calculated Qi Shen's age—he was probably nearing thirty.

text: 豪门世家的继承人，这个年纪早该结婚了。
en: As the heir to a great family, at that age he ought long since to have married.

text: “专心点。
en: “Pay attention.

text: ”男人吻了下她的耳垂。
en: ”The man kissed her earlobe.

text: 她像是被他握在了手心里的木偶，无路可去，不由自己掌控。
en: She was like a puppet held in the palm of his hand, with nowhere to go and no control over herself.

text: 时思遥忽然往后一缩，抬手推拒了男人进一步的动作。
en: Siyao Shi suddenly shrank back and raised her hands to fend off the man's further advances.

text: “不要！
en: “No!

text: 祁深的眼镜还没摘，镜片之后，漆黑的眸子已经染上了她已经熟悉的暗色。
en: Qi Shen had not yet removed his glasses; behind the lenses, his pitch-black eyes had already taken on the dark hue she had come to know.

text: 他知道时思遥有求于他，但这种时候推拒谈条件，可不是聪明之举。
en: He knew Siyao Shi needed something from him, but to refuse and bargain at a time like this was not a wise move.

text: 他握住女人的脚踝，避开了扭伤的地方，将她拉到了身边。
en: He grasped the woman's ankle, avoiding the sprained spot, and pulled her to his side.

text: 时思遥连连摇头，躲避着他。
en: Siyao Shi shook her head repeatedly, shrinking away from him.

text: 祁深察觉不对，倒吸一口气停下，捏住了她的下巴。
en: Qi Shen sensed something was wrong; he drew a sharp breath, stopped, and pinched her chin.

text: “怎么了？
en: “What is it?

text: “您结婚了！
en: “You're married!

text: 时思遥目光无措地看着他。
en: Siyao Shi looked at him helplessly, her eyes adrift.

text: 她刚被人插足恋情，最痛恨第三者，绝不会去染指别人的婚姻。
en: She had just had her romance ruined by a third party, and hated home-wreckers most of all; she would never touch another's marriage.

text: 祁深敏锐，低头看了眼手上的戒指。
en: Qi Shen was sharp; he lowered his head and glanced at the ring on his hand.

text: 他记得她的经历，再抬头看她眼底的痛恨，被打断的不悦忽然就消失了。
en: He remembered what she had been through, and when he looked up again and saw the loathing in her eyes, the displeasure at being interrupted suddenly vanished.

text: 他轻啄她的嘴唇，没有解释，只是说：“没结婚，戴着玩儿的。
en: He pecked her lips lightly, offered no explanation, and only said, “Not married—just wearing it for fun.

text: 这种说辞，时思遥岂会相信。
en: How could Siyao Shi possibly believe such an excuse.

text: 然而祁深没有给她思考的机会，他单手将她捞了起来，抱着她向床上走去。
en: Yet Qi Shen gave her no chance to think; with one arm he scooped her up and carried her towards the bed.

text: 身体被抛上大床，颠得她头晕。
en: Her body was tossed onto the large bed, jolting her so that her head spun.

text: 时思遥撑起身，男人挡住了她的光，投落的阴影将她牢牢盖住，他站在窗边，慢条斯理地褪去身上束缚。
en: Siyao Shi propped herself up; the man blocked her light, and the shadow he cast covered her completely. Standing by the window, he unhurriedly shed the constraints upon him.

text: 对上他幽深发沉的眸子，她忽然意识到，现在的情况不是她能主宰的。
en: Meeting his deep, heavy-lidded eyes, she suddenly realised the situation was not one she could command.

text: 他想怎么样，就怎么样。
en: He would do as he pleased.

text: 她被迫承受，两厢对比，手上推拒他的力量显得微不足道。
en: She was forced to endure; by comparison, the strength with which she pushed him away seemed utterly negligible.

text: 时思遥身体簌簌发抖，她攥紧了床单。
en: Siyao Shi trembled all over, and clutched the bedsheet tightly.

text: “祁深，住手！
en: “Qi Shen, stop!

text: 娇娇软软的声音，喊着他的名字，说着拒绝的话，却更像是邀请，祁深都有点佩服她，经验不多，倒是知道怎么勾他。
en: That soft, sweet voice called his name and spoke words of refusal, yet it sounded more like an invitation; Qi Shen rather admired her for it—little experience she might have, but she knew how to tease him.

text: 他正要有动作，忽然，床头座机传来急促的铃声。
en: He was about to move when, suddenly, the urgent ring of the bedside landline came through.

text: 祁深眉心微收，只要他在，房间里不会来随便的电话。
en: Qi Shen's brows drew in slightly; so long as he was there, no casual call would come to the room.

text: 他捏了捏女孩儿的耳朵，无声地安抚，然后毫不犹豫地起身离开这，按了免提。
en: He gave the girl's ear a little pinch, soothing her without a word, then rose without hesitation and left, pressing the speakerphone.

text: “祁先生您好，这里是前台。
en: “Hello, Mr Qi, this is the front desk.

text: 前台声音温和，“您未婚妻林小姐来了，在大厅等您，您看…
en: The receptionist's voice was gentle: “Your fiancée, Miss Lin, has arrived and is waiting for you in the lobby. We were wondering…

text: 未婚妻？
en: Fiancée?

text: 祁深眸色一冷。
en: Qi Shen's eyes turned cold.

text: 他转过脸看向时思遥，女孩一副果然的表情，眼里忿忿毫不掩饰。
en: He turned to look at Siyao Shi; the girl wore an expression of knowing it all along, her indignation utterly undisguised.

text: 他唇瓣微抿。
en: His lips pressed together slightly.

text: 电话里，前台又说：“您母亲也在。
en: Over the phone, the receptionist went on: “Your mother is here as well.

text: 听到此处，祁深脸上已见沉色，他声音淡淡：“告诉她们，我半小时后下来。
en: Hearing this, a dark look had already come over Qi Shen's face; his voice was flat: “Tell them I'll be down in half an hour.
“This…

text: 前台还想再说什么，祁深已经把电话挂断了。
en: The receptionist was about to say more, but Qi Shen had already hung up.

text: 他坐在床沿，看了一眼时思遥，“过来。
en: He sat on the edge of the bed, gave Siyao Shi a glance, and said, “Come here.

text: 时思遥哪里还会听他的，她现在只想穿上衣服赶紧走。
en: Why would Siyao Shi still listen to him now? All she wanted was to get dressed and leave at once.

text: 然而刚有这念头，祁深就好像有读心术一样，拽着她的脚踝，就把她带到了面前。
en: Yet no sooner had the thought formed than Qi Shen, as if reading her mind, grabbed her ankle and dragged her before him.

text: 时思遥身形不稳，落地之时，只能扶住他的腿，跪坐在了他身前的地毯上。
en: Siyao Shi lost her balance; when she landed, she could only brace herself against his leg and ended up kneeling on the carpet before him.

text: 饶是如此，脸还在撞在了他皮带上。
en: Even so, her face bumped against his belt.

text: 羞耻感炸开，她仰起头，唇瓣都咬死了。
en: Shame exploded within her; she tilted her head up, biting her lips shut.

text: 男人脱了衣服，压迫感反而更甚，就像是卸下伪装，暴露了原始的样子。
en: With his clothes off, the man's oppressive presence was all the greater, as though he had shed his disguise and laid bare his primal self.

text: 他略微俯身，粗粝手指抚过她的唇瓣，带着某种暗示。
en: He bent slightly and, with a calloused finger, brushed her lips, carrying a certain implication.

text: “听到了？
en: “Heard that?

text: 我只有半小时。
en: I've only got half an hour.

text: “有什么事，过后我再听你慢慢说。
en: “Whatever it is, I'll listen to you explain slowly afterwards.

text: 他已经给出承诺了，她应该能明白。
en: He had already given his word; she ought to understand.

text: 男人握着她的手，有些不可抗拒。
en: The man held her hand, with something of an irresistible force.

text: “现在，先解决我。
en: “For now, deal with me first.

text: 酒店大厅
en: Hotel lobby

text: 祁深下楼时，已经洗好澡，换了一身西装。
en: By the time Qi Shen came downstairs, he had bathed and changed into a suit.

text: 祁夫人正在看杂志，身边，林悦珊指着杂志上的珠宝，跟她说着话。
en: Mrs Qi was reading a magazine; beside her, Yueshan Lin was pointing at the jewellery in the magazine and talking to her.

text: 祁深走下来，林悦珊一眼就看到了他。
en: As Qi Shen walked down, Yueshan Lin spotted him at once.

text: “祁深。
en: “Qi Shen.

text: 闻声，祁夫人抬起了头，她不留痕迹地把儿子上下打量了一番，察觉他洗过澡。
en: At the sound, Mrs Qi looked up; she took her son in from head to toe without betraying it, and noticed he had bathed.

text: 知子莫若母，她没点破，说：“怎么才下来，我和悦珊等了你快一个小时了。
en: A mother knows her son best; she did not expose it, and said, “What took you so long? Yueshan and I have waited nearly an hour.

text: 祁深神色淡淡，在沙发上坐下，唇瓣掀动：“前台通知我，说我未婚妻来了。
en: Qi Shen's expression was flat; he sat on the sofa and said, “The front desk informed me that my fiancée had arrived.

text: 我还没见过我未婚妻，第一次见面，当然得郑重相待。
en: I've never met my fiancée; for a first meeting, of course I had to treat it with due solemnity.

text: 祁夫人诧异，随即看向林悦珊。
en: Mrs Qi was surprised, then looked towards Yueshan Lin.

text: 林悦珊面上泛起薄粉，秀眉皱起，一脸茫然地道：“未婚妻？
en: Yueshan Lin's face flushed faintly pink; her delicate brows knitted, and she said, looking utterly bewildered, “Fiancée?

text: 前台是这么说的吗？
en: Is that what the front desk said?

text: 我没让他们这么说。
en: I never told them to say that.

text: 祁夫人心里门儿清。
en: Mrs Qi knew perfectly well what was going on.

text: 她收回视线，看向祁深：“连前台都觉得悦珊和你郎才女貌，主观臆断了，你看你，还不抓紧机会？
en: She withdrew her gaze and looked at Qi Shen: “Even the front desk thinks Yueshan and you are a perfect match—a subjective assumption, true—but look at you, won't you seize the chance?

text: 林悦珊脸上更红，抱住了祁夫人手臂，嗔道：“阿姨——”
en: Yueshan Lin's face grew redder; she hugged Mrs Qi's arm and said coquettishly, “Auntie—”

text: 祁夫人拍了拍她的手臂，笑容温和，眼神却睨了下祁深。
en: Mrs Qi patted her arm, her smile gentle, though her eyes slid sidelong towards Qi Shen.

text: 祁深此刻心情不错，却也没耐心看林悦珊演戏。
en: Qi Shen was in a fair mood at the moment, yet had no patience to watch Yueshan Lin put on her act.

text: 他看了眼祁夫人，“找我有事？
en: He glanced at Mrs Qi: “Do you need something from me?

text: “你都个把月不回家了，打你电话也总是敷衍，要不是悦珊陪我来吃饭，听说你在这里，你妈我还不知道猴年马月才能见到你呢。
en: “You haven't been home for over a month, and when I call you, you always fob me off. If Yueshan hadn't come with me to eat and heard you were here, your mother wouldn't have known when on earth she'd next see you.

text: “最近忙。
en: “Been busy lately.

text: “你就搪塞我吧。
en: “You're just fobbing me off.

text: 祁夫人有段日子没见儿子，有些话，得私下说。
en: Mrs Qi had not seen her son for some time, and there were things she needed to say in private.

text: 她对林悦珊道：“今天你也累了，早点回去吧，替我向你母亲问好。
en: She said to Yueshan Lin, “You must be tired today too; head home early, and give my regards to your mother.

text: 林悦珊耽误这一小时，本就是听说祁深带了人上楼，想通过祁母见见是什么人。
en: The reason Yueshan Lin had spent this hour was that she had heard Qi Shen had brought someone upstairs, and wanted, through Mrs Qi, to see who it was.

text: 如今没见着，她心有不甘。
en: Now that she had not seen, she was reluctant to let it go.

text: 可看祁夫人下逐客令，她也不好不识趣，只能顺从地撒撒娇。
en: But seeing Mrs Qi issuing her a dismissal, she could hardly be tactless, and could only comply with a little coquettishness.

text: “那我过几天约您喝茶。
en: “Then I'll invite you for tea in a few days.
“All right.

text: 看着林悦珊走开，祁夫人才瞪了一眼儿子。
en: Only after watching Yueshan Lin walk away did Mrs Qi shoot her son a glare.

text: “是什么人？
en: “Who is she?

text: 祁深没接茬，“什么？
en: Qi Shen did not take the bait: “What?

text: “别装傻，你在外边养人了？
en: “Stop playing dumb—you've got someone on the side, haven't you?

text: ”祁夫人直白地问。
en: ”Mrs Qi asked bluntly.

text: 养？
en: Keeping one?

text: 倒还不至于。
en: Not quite to that extent.

text: 不过，可以考虑。
en: But it could be considered.

text: 他不说话，祁夫人当他是默认，只道：“你养着谁，我管不着你。
en: He said nothing, and Mrs Qi took that as admission, saying only, “Whoever you keep, I won't interfere in that.

text: 不过，年底得把婚事定了。
en: Still, the marriage must be settled by year's end.

text: 说到订婚，祁深眉心几不可闻地皱了下。
en: At the mention of the engagement, Qi Shen's brows knitted almost imperceptibly.

text: 祁夫人知道他的脾气，祁家男人都一个德性，看着斯文稳重，其实骨子里最桀骜不驯，撕下那层皮，可劲儿地撒野。
en: Mrs Qi knew his temperament: the men of the Qi family are all of a kind—they look refined and steady, but at heart are the most untameable, and once that skin is stripped away, they run wild without restraint.

text: 她想正经劝两句，祁深已经起了身。
en: She meant to offer a word of serious advice, but Qi Shen had already risen.

text: “再说吧。
en: “We'll talk later.

text: 祁夫人叹了口气，匆匆跟着起来，瞥到他手上的戒指，嘴角勾起满意的弧度。
en: Mrs Qi sighed, and hurriedly stood as well; catching sight of the ring on his hand, the corners of her mouth curved into a satisfied arc.

text: “戒指还戴着就好。
en: “As long as you're still wearing the ring.

text: 祁深脚步停了下，看了眼无名指上的戒指。
en: Qi Shen paused mid-step and looked at the ring on his ring finger.

text: 祁夫人说：“大师说了，这戒指能招正缘的桃花，保你婚事顺利，你可不许摘啊。
en: Mrs Qi said, “The master said this ring attracts peach-blossom luck for a proper match and ensures your marriage goes smoothly—you must not take it off.

text: 招桃花？
en: Attract peach-blossom luck?

text: 祁深一时无语。
en: For a moment Qi Shen was speechless.

text: 他想起刚才在楼上，时思遥匍匐在他脚边，被他半强迫地做了那事，仰头时，看他的眼神都像是在看一个人渣，要不是他掐着她腮帮子，估计得咬他。
en: He thought of just now upstairs, when Siyao Shi had crawled at his feet and, half-forced, done that thing with him; when she looked up, her eyes had regarded him as if he were scum, and had he not been pinching her cheeks, she would probably have bitten him.

text: 他摘了下戒指，放在祁夫人手里。
en: He slipped the ring off and placed it in Mrs Qi's hand.

text: “没用，下回别再被神棍骗了。
en: “Useless. Don't let those charlatans fool you again next time.

text: 祁夫人：？
en: Mrs Qi: ?

text: 路边
en: Roadside

text: 时思遥从计程车上下来，麻木地付了车钱，脚下虚浮地往老公寓里走。
en: Siyao Shi got down from the taxi, paid the fare numbly, and walked towards the old apartment building on unsteady feet.

text: 老楼年久失修，灯光黯淡。
en: The old building was long fallen into disrepair, its lighting dim.

text: 她刚上二楼，就险些摔一跤，身体稳住了，手里的东西却摔了出去。
en: She had just reached the second floor when she nearly fell; she steadied herself, but the thing in her hand went flying.

text: 是一只香奈儿的礼盒。
en: It was a Chanel gift box.

text: 祁深的秘书送她下楼时，连带着名片一起拿给她的。
en: Qi Shen's secretary had given it to her, along with a name card, when seeing her downstairs.

text: 看到包，刚压下去的耻辱感又涌了上来。
en: Seeing the bag, the shame she had just suppressed welled up again.

text: 唇间的气息还在，提醒着她，半小时前，她跪在一个已婚男人腿边，做了多下贱的事。
en: The breath between her lips still lingered, reminding her that half an hour ago she had knelt at the side of a married man's legs and done something utterly degrading.

text: 这个包，大概就是她的劳务报酬。
en: This bag was probably her payment for the labour.

text: 这么想着，她抓住口袋里的名片，毫不留恋地丢进了身边的垃圾桶里！
en: Thinking thus, she grabbed the name card from her pocket and, without the slightest reluctance, threw it into the rubbish bin beside her!

text: 混蛋！
en: Bastard!

text: 跟周治学一样的混蛋！
en: A bastard just like Zhou Zhixue!

text: 她没捡起包，拖着身躯往楼上走。
en: She did not pick up the bag, but dragged herself upstairs.

text: 推开小屋的门，她靠在门上，才觉得身体瘫软，支撑不住。
en: Pushing open the door of the little room, she leaned against it, and only then felt her body go limp, unable to hold herself up.

text: 忽然，黑暗里传来声音。
en: Suddenly, a voice came from the darkness.

text: “为什么这么晚才回来？
en: “Why did you come back so late?

text: 时思遥立刻分辨出来人是谁，她想起来了，家里的钥匙周治学还没还给她！
en: Siyao Shi immediately recognised who it was; she remembered—Zhou Zhixue still had not returned the key to her home!

text: 啪得一下打开灯。
en: She switched on the light with a snap.

text: 不远处，西装革履，人模狗样的，不是周治学，还能有谁。
en: Not far off, dressed smartly in a suit, putting on airs—who else could it be but Zhou Zhixue.

text: 都说男人是天生的演员，这人更是其中翘楚。
en: They say men are born actors, and this one was the very champion of them.

text: 他长相英俊，平常对她都很温柔，现在面色阴沉，让时思遥背脊发凉。
en: Handsome of face, he had always been gentle with her; now his expression was dark and cold, sending a chill down Siyao Shi's spine.

text: 她还没来得及赶他，他已经先质问她。
en: Before she could even order him out, he had already demanded of her.

text: “你去见邹国明了？
en: “You went to see Guoming Zou?

text: 时思遥知道，他一定也看到班群里的讨论了。
en: Siyao Shi knew he must have seen the discussion in the class group chat as well.

text: 她舒了口气，不想跟他多说，“我见谁跟你无关，现在请你从我家出去，把钥匙留下。
en: She breathed out, unwilling to say more to him: “Who I see is none of your business. Now please leave my home and leave the key behind.

text: 她还是这幅脾气，周治学面色反而和缓了。
en: She was still her same stubborn self, and Zhou Zhixue's expression actually softened.

text: 对他，她都不肯低头，更何况是对邹国明那种人。
en: Towards him, she would not bow her head; all the more so towards someone like Guoming Zou.

text: “到任何时候，你的事我都管得着。
en: “At any time, I have a say in your affairs.

text: 时思遥根本不想看到他，她直接掏了手机准备报警。
en: Siyao Shi had no wish at all to see him; she simply pulled out her phone to call the police.

text: 周治学却先她一步，抢了她的手机丢在一边，顺势牢牢地箍紧她的腰。
en: But Zhou Zhixue moved faster; he snatched her phone and tossed it aside, then firmly locked his arms around her waist.

text: “放手！
en: “Let go!

text: ”时思遥惊呼。
en: ”Siyao Shi cried out.

text: 周治学强行带着她往里，把她压在了沙发里。
en: Zhou Zhixue forcibly pulled her inward and pinned her into the sofa.

text: “出国的事，考虑的怎么样？
en: “How are you getting on with thinking about going abroad?

text: 时思遥挣扎着，恨恨道：“你休想！
en: Siyao Shi struggled and said through gritted teeth, “You dream on!

text: 周治学视线紧盯着她的脸，注意到她泛着嫣红的唇瓣。
en: Zhou Zhixue's gaze fixed on her face, and he noticed her lips, which glowed a vivid red.

text: 脸色微沉，“你跟人接吻了？
en: His expression darkened slightly: “You've been kissing someone?

text: 时思遥一怔。
en: Siyao Shi froze.

text: 她忽然有种报复的快感，想都没想就点头，“不仅接吻了，还睡了！
en: She suddenly felt a thrill of revenge, and nodded without thinking: “Not just kissing—we slept together!

text: 周治学有片刻的失控，可看到时思遥倔强的脸，他立刻说服了自己。
en: Zhou Zhixue lost his composure for a moment, but seeing Siyao Shi's stubborn face, he immediately convinced himself otherwise.

text: 不可能。
en: Impossible.

text: 他的遥遥不会做这种事。
en: His Yaoyao would never do such a thing.

text: 大概是为了增加可信度，他猛地低头去吻时思遥，
en: Perhaps to make it more convincing, he abruptly lowered his head to kiss Siyao Shi,

text: 时思遥叫喊着躲避，用尽全身力气往外推他，用头撞他。
en: and Siyao Shi cried out and dodged, using all her strength to push him away and butting him with her head.

text: 周治学没想到她反应这么激烈，也狠下心，用力握住她手腕，将人再度压回沙发里！
en: Zhou Zhixue had not expected her to react so violently; he hardened his heart, gripped her wrist tightly, and pinned her back into the sofa!

text: 疯劲儿上来，想着干脆今晚就要了她！
en: The madness rising in him, he thought he might as well take her tonight!

text: 省得她被别人盯上。
en: So she would not be eyed by others.

text: 念头一出，他抽了领带打算捆住时思遥的手。
en: No sooner had the thought formed than he pulled off his tie, meaning to bind Siyao Shi's hands.

text: 可眼神一扫，却注意到了她锁骨间突兀的红痕。
en: But a glance caught the abrupt red mark between her collarbones.

text: 吻痕？
en: A love bite?

text: 他一把按住时思遥，拇指按着她锁骨上的痕迹，厉声质问：“这是谁弄的？
en: He pressed Siyao Shi down, his thumb on the mark at her collarbone, and demanded harshly, “Who did this?

text: 时思遥被他按得疼了，理智却回了笼。
en: Pressed painfully by him, Siyao Shi's reason nevertheless returned.

text: 抬眼看着他那张布满阴云的脸，她故意道：“如你所见，我跟人睡了，已经不符合你心目中纯洁无暇的幻想了，麻烦你大发慈悲放过我吧！
en: Looking up at his face, clouded with gloom, she said deliberately, “As you can see, I slept with someone; I no longer fit the fantasy of spotless purity in your mind. Might you, in your great mercy, let me go!

text: “我问你谁弄的！
en: “I asked who did it!

text: 周治学几乎要疯了。
en: Zhou Zhixue was nearly driven mad.

text: 时思遥却越发冷静，她梗着脖子，微微一笑：“路边遇到的野男人而已，我不认识。
en: Siyao Shi grew all the calmer; she stuck out her neck and smiled faintly: “Just some random man I met on the roadside; I don't know him.

text: 此话一出，周治学眼里漫起无边的痛苦和恨意。
en: At these words, boundless pain and hatred welled up in Zhou Zhixue's eyes.

text: 他掐死时思遥的心都有。
en: He could have throttled Siyao Shi then and there.

text: “遥遥，你够狠！
en: “Yaoyao, you're vicious!

text: 他咬牙说着，从时思遥身上下去了。
en: He said through clenched teeth, and got off Siyao Shi.

text: 时思遥以为他终于要放弃她，却听得他说：“背叛我，是要付出代价的。
en: Siyao Shi thought he was finally going to give her up, but instead heard him say, “To betray me comes at a price.

text: 真可笑。
en: How ridiculous.

text: 他们之间到底谁才是背叛的那个！
en: Just who between them was the one who betrayed!

text: 周治学压下了情绪，抬手整理衬衫。
en: Zhou Zhixue suppressed his emotions and raised a hand to straighten his shirt.

text: 他后退一步，看着时思遥道：“明天来公司上班。
en: He took a step back and, looking at Siyao Shi, said, “Come to the office for work tomorrow.

text: 时思遥几乎要笑了，他害得她背上挪用公款的罪名，随时都有可能锒铛入狱。
en: Siyao Shi was nearly about to laugh; he had pinned on her the charge of embezzlement, and at any moment she could be thrown into prison.

text: 他竟然还让她回去上班？
en: And yet he still expected her to go back to work?

text: “我不去。
en: “I'm not going.

text: “由不得你。
en: “It is not up to you.

text: 男人英俊的脸上又恢复了面无表情，他缓缓道：“你外婆下周一动手术吧？
en: The man's handsome face settled back into an expressionless look, and he said slowly, “Your grandmother is having her operation next Monday, is she?

text: 时思遥精神一紧，“你想干什么？
en: Siyao Shi's nerves tightened. “What are you trying to do?

text: “我冻结了我们的联合账户。
en: “I have frozen our joint account.

text: 时思遥瞪大了眼睛，“你凭什么！
en: Siyao Shi widened her eyes. “On what grounds!

text: 周治学冷笑：“你的钱都在联合账户里，我不同意解冻，你拿什么给你外婆交手术费？
en: Zhixue Zhou gave a cold laugh. “All your money is in the joint account. If I do not agree to unfreeze it, what will you use to pay your grandmother's operation fees?

text: 时思遥不敢置信，他竟然下作到这种地步。
en: Siyao Shi could not believe it — he had sunk to such a despicable low.

text: “那里面有一半是我的工资和外婆卖房的钱！
en: “Half of that is my salary and the money from my grandmother selling her house!

text: 周治学，你还有良心吗？
en: Zhixue Zhou, do you have any conscience left?

text: 我外婆把你当真亲人一样看待！
en: My grandmother treated you like a true member of the family!

text: 周治学面无波澜，他抬了抬下巴，“开联合账户，是你自愿的，我没逼你。
en: Zhixue Zhou's face was unmoved. He lifted his chin. “Opening the joint account was your own choice. I did not force you.

text: 时思遥僵在原地，气得脸色煞白。
en: Siyao Shi stood frozen on the spot, her face deathly pale with rage.

text: 当初开联合账户，是为了存他们的买房基金。
en: Back then, they had opened the joint account to save up their house-buying fund.

text: 后来，周治学生意有了气色，他一下子往里打了三百万。
en: Later, Zhixue Zhou's business picked up, and he transferred three million into it in one go.

text: 她告诉外婆后，外婆说不能让男方出这么多，第二天就让她把卖老房的钱存进了联合账户。
en: After she told her grandmother, her grandmother said they could not let the man contribute so much, and the next day had her deposit the money from selling her old house into the joint account.

text: 不出意外，他们原本今年就要结婚了！
en: Barring any accident, they had been due to marry this year!

text: 现在，他竟然用这笔钱来逼她，还罔顾外婆的性命。
en: Now he was actually using this money to pressure her, and disregarding her grandmother's very life.

text: 她恶心得快要吐了。
en: She felt so sick she could almost vomit.

text: 周治学没再看她，撂下一句话。
en: Zhixue Zhou did not look at her again; he left a parting remark.

text: “明天上午，我要在公司看到你。
en: “Tomorrow morning, I want to see you at the office.

text: 我心情好的话，周一之前，账户说不定还能解冻！
en: If I am in a good mood, the account might just get unfrozen before Monday!

text: 时思遥瘫在沙发上，面如死灰。
en: Siyao Shi slumped on the sofa, her face ashen.

text: 枯坐一夜后，第二天还是重新去上班。
en: After sitting blankly through the night, she went back to work the next day all the same.

text: 她无路可走，外婆的手术不能再拖。
en: She had no way out; her grandmother's operation could not be delayed any longer.

text: 当初，她一毕业就进了周治学的公司，为了不违背周治学定下的“办公室不允许恋爱”条例，同意发展地下恋情，但也靠着自己的能力做到了财务主管的位置。
en: Back then, she had joined Zhixue Zhou's company straight after graduation. To avoid violating the rule he had laid down — “no romantic relationships allowed in the office” — she had agreed to keep their romance underground, yet through her own ability she had risen to the position of finance supervisor.

text: 如今回到公司，周治学故意把她从财务主管撸到了财务助理，办公室的人都以为她得罪周治学了，明着不欺负她，暗里也给她使绊子。
en: Now that she was back at the company, Zhixue Zhou deliberately demoted her from finance supervisor to finance assistant. Everyone in the office assumed she had fallen out of favour with him; they did not bully her openly, but they tripped her up behind her back.

text: 三天下来，几乎累脱了一层皮。
en: After three days, she was all but worked to the bone.

text: 这天，她刚想歇一会儿，办公室门口就传来热闹动静。
en: That day, just as she was about to rest a moment, a commotion arose at the office door.

text: 时思遥抬头一看，立刻别过了脸。
en: Siyao Shi looked up and immediately turned her face away.

text: 乔大小姐来了。
en: Young Miss Qiao had arrived.

text: 她本想借去洗手间离开座位，不料，乔琳宣却叫住了她。
en: She had meant to slip away to the lavatory, but Linxuan Qiao called her to a halt.

text: “你过来。
en: “You, come here.

text: 众人都看过来。
en: Everyone turned to look.

text: 时思遥瞥到外面周治学的背影，压着情绪上前。
en: Siyao Shi caught a glimpse of Zhixue Zhou's retreating back outside, and stepped forward, suppressing her emotions.

text: “乔小姐。
en: “Miss Qiao.

text: 乔琳宣问她：“你叫时思遥是吧？
en: Linxuan Qiao asked her, “Your name is Siyao Shi, isn't it?
“Yes.

text: 乔琳宣点头，看了下手表，“拿上包，跟我和周总出去一趟。
en: Linxuan Qiao nodded and glanced at her watch. “Grab your bag and come out with me and Mr Zhou.

text: 说完，她径直出了办公室，没给时思遥拒绝的机会。
en: With that, she walked straight out of the office, giving Siyao Shi no chance to refuse.

text: 一时，周围众人神色各异。
en: For a moment, those around them wore varied expressions.

text: 时思遥被迫跟出去，周治学刚打好电话，一看到她跟乔琳宣在一起，他脸色明显变了下。
en: Forced to follow, Siyao Shi found Zhixue Zhou just off the phone; the moment he saw her with Linxuan Qiao, his expression visibly shifted.

text: 乔琳宣却笑着挽住了他的手臂，“走吧。
en: Yet Linxuan Qiao smiled and linked her arm through his. “Let's go.

text: “我们出去，你叫上别人做什么？
en: We're going out — why did you bring someone else along?

text: ”周治学眉心微收。
en: ” Zhixue Zhou's brows drew slightly together.

text: 乔琳宣嗔了他一眼，“我没带助理，总得有个人拎包吧？
en: Linxuan Qiao shot him a playful glance. “I didn't bring an assistant; someone has to carry the bags, surely?

text: 听到她这么说，周治学松了口气。
en: Hearing her say this, Zhixue Zhou breathed a sigh of relief.

text: “你的包有多重，我给你拎还不够？
en: “However heavy your bag is, isn't it enough that I carry it for you?

text: “我可舍不得你辛苦。
en: “I couldn't bear to let you tire yourself.

text: 再说了…
en: Besides…

text: ”她话锋一转，视线在时思遥那张出众的脸蛋上扫过，“舍不得这么漂亮的小助理出门吃苦啊？
en: ” She changed tack, her gaze sweeping across Siyao Shi's striking face. “I couldn't bear to let such a pretty little assistant suffer out here, could I?

text: “说什么呢。
en: “What nonsense.

text: 周治学捏了下她的脸，随即转向时思遥。
en: Zhixue Zhou pinched her cheek, then turned to Siyao Shi.

text: “乔小姐让你跟着，你就跟着吧。
en: “Miss Qiao says follow, so just follow.

text: 他口吻随意，但时思遥还是听出了警告。
en: His tone was casual, but Siyao Shi still heard the warning in it.

text: 想起外婆的事，她不动声色攥紧了手，应了一声。
en: Thinking of her grandmother, she tightened her hand without a flicker of expression and gave a murmur of assent.

text: 乔琳宣见状，面上高兴，玩着周治学往外走。
en: Linxuan Qiao, pleased at this, looped her arm through Zhixue Zhou's and headed out.

text: 上了车，他们俩坐了后座，时思遥坐了副驾驶。
en: Once in the car, the two of them took the back seat while Siyao Shi sat in the front passenger seat.

text: 一路上，后面都是说说笑笑，偶尔传来暧日未声响。
en: All the way, those in the back kept up a stream of chatter and laughter; now and then the sound of soft murmuring drifted back.

text: 时思遥从后视镜中，几次看到周治学投来的眼神。
en: From the rear-view mirror, Siyao Shi caught Zhixue Zhou's gaze upon her several times.

text: 她知道，他是故意的，无非是想刺激她，报复她的“背叛”。
en: She knew he was doing it on purpose — merely to provoke her, to punish her for her “betrayal”.

text: 她闭上眼睛，只当没看见。
en: She closed her eyes and pretended not to see.

text: 目的地是檀山脚下的一家高档俱乐部，下了车，乔琳宣把包丢给时思遥，和周治学走在前面。
en: Their destination was an upmarket club at the foot of Tan Mountain. After getting out, Linxuan Qiao tossed her bag to Siyao Shi and walked ahead with Zhixue Zhou.

text: “我主要是带你过来见个人，见他一面可不容易，就算不深交，混个熟脸也是好的。
en: “I mainly brought you here to meet someone. It is not easy to get an audience with him; even if you don't become close, it is good to put a familiar face to the name.

text: “什么人这么难见？
en: “Who is so hard to meet?

text: “等会儿见了你就知道了。
en: “You'll find out when you meet him in a bit.

text: 时思遥跟在后面，一言不发。
en: Siyao Shi followed behind in silence.

text: 走过室内，到了室外，是一片设施完备的网球场。
en: Walking through the indoor area to the outdoors, they came upon a fully equipped tennis court.

text: 不远处，有遮阳篷搭着。
en: Not far off, a sunshade canopy had been set up.

text: 几位年轻男子坐在下面，正在看场中人打球。
en: Several young men sat beneath it, watching the players on court.

text: 乔琳宣边走边打招呼，“承禹哥，还真是你们啊。
en: As she walked, Linxuan Qiao called out a greeting. “Brother Chengyu, so it really is you lot.

text: 她言语惊讶，仿佛只是巧遇一般。
en: Her tone was one of surprise, as if it were merely a chance encounter.

text: 朝她看过来的男人很年轻，脸上罩着大蛤蟆镜，一身简单的夏季运动服，靠坐在桌边，嘴角噙着一抹笑。
en: The man who looked over at her was very young, his face hidden behind large wraparound sunglasses, dressed in simple summer sportswear, leaning back by the table with a faint smile playing at his lips.

text: 但看露出来的半张脸，也是俊美非常。
en: But the half of his face that showed was strikingly handsome.

text: 时思遥不认识这人的脸，但听名字立刻就知道。
en: Siyao Shi did not recognise his face, but the name told her at once.

text: 这是应家七少，应承禹。
en: This was Chengyu Ying, the seventh young master of the Ying family.

text: 旁边那位一脸冷漠的自然是号称金牌律师的傅家二公子傅修，两人私交甚好并不是什么秘密。
en: The cold-faced one beside him was naturally Xiu Fu, the second young master of the Fu family, famed as a top lawyer; that the two were on close private terms was no secret.

text: 看清来人，应承禹也没起身，懒洋洋地说：“琳琳啊。
en: Seeing who it was, Chengyu Ying did not rise either, but said lazily, “Linlin, ah.

text: 乔琳宣也不在意，顺便跟傅修问了好。
en: Linxuan Qiao did not mind, and took the chance to greet Xiu Fu as well.

text: “我跟我男朋友刚好过来，听说几个哥哥在，带他过来见见你们。
en: “My boyfriend and I just happened to come by, and hearing a few of you brothers were here, I brought him over to meet you.

text: 闻言，应承禹倒是多看了周治学一眼。
en: At this, Chengyu Ying gave Zhixue Zhou an extra glance.

text: 周治学淡淡点头，不卑不亢地自报家门：“周治学。
en: Zhixue Zhou gave a faint nod and introduced himself, neither obsequious nor proud. “Zhixue Zhou.

text: 乔琳宣最爱的就是他这一点，骨子里的骄傲。
en: This was exactly what Linxuan Qiao loved about him — the pride in his bones.

text: 应承禹也算给面子，回了周治学一个点头。
en: Chengyu Ying, being courteous in return, nodded back at Zhixue Zhou.

text: 一抬眼，注意到了后面的时思遥，突然来了兴趣。
en: Raising his eyes, he noticed Siyao Shi behind them and suddenly took interest.

text: “怎么你们两口子出门，后面还跟个仙女伺候？
en: “How is it that when you two go out, you've got a fairy trailing behind to wait on you?

text: 时思遥站在后面，注意力有点分散，她看到了场中的人，隐约觉得身影有些熟悉。
en: Standing at the back, Siyao Shi's attention was somewhat scattered; she looked at the players on court and felt vaguely that one figure looked familiar.

text: 闻声，她还未回神，就被乔琳宣拉到了前面。
en: At the sound of his voice, before she had quite collected herself, Linxuan Qiao pulled her to the front.

text: “什么呀，这是我们家周总公司的财务，正经文化人，南大高材生。
en: “Oh, nothing of the sort — she's finance staff at Mr Zhou's company, a proper educated sort, a top graduate of Nanda.

text: 她说罢，应承禹挑了下眉。
en: When she finished, Chengyu Ying raised an eyebrow.

text: “哟，还是个学霸。
en: “Oh, a straight-A student, no less.

text: 时思遥站在前面，不得不开口：“应少过奖了。
en: Standing at the front, Siyao Shi had no choice but to speak. “You flatter me, Young Master Ying.

text: “叫什么名字？
en: “What's your name?

text: “时思遥，时间的时，宁静的宁。
en: “Siyao Shi — ‘Shi’ from ‘time’, and ‘Ning’ from ‘tranquillity’.

text: 时思遥刚说完，一旁看着场内战况的傅修轻啧了一声。
en: No sooner had Siyao Shi finished than Xiu Fu, watching the match beside them, gave a soft click of the tongue.

text: 应承禹也随即看向场内，幸灾乐祸。
en: Chengyu Ying too turned to look at the court, gloating.

text: “难得，咱们祁总今天手感不够啊，居然连跪了。
en: “Rare indeed — our Mr Qi's touch is off today; he's actually losing streak after streak.

text: 时思遥眸色一晃。
en: Siyao Shi's eyes flickered.

text: 祁？
en: Qi?

text: 时思遥本以为是自己太敏感了，听到祁字就能联想到那人。
en: Siyao Shi had thought herself oversensitive — that hearing the surname Qi alone made her think of that man.

text: 可没过几分钟，场中几人过来中场休息。
en: Yet within minutes, several players came over for a mid-game break.

text: 为首的，不是祁深还有谁。
en: The one leading them could be no one but Shen Qi.

text: 因为打网球，他换了一身夏季运动服，跟应承禹的打扮没什么不同，却完全是另外一种气场，只是比西装革履时多了两分年轻感。
en: Because of the tennis, he had changed into summer sportswear no different from Chengyu Ying's outfit, yet his bearing was altogether another matter — only with a touch more youthfulness than when in suit and leather shoes.

text: 天本就热，时思遥脸上一直都有些发烫，看到他的片刻，脸上温度更高了。
en: It was already hot, and Siyao Shi's face had been flushed all along; the moment she saw him, her face grew even hotter.

text: 那两次的记忆，怎么都压不住。
en: The memories of those two times could not be suppressed, no matter what.

text: “祁深哥。
en: “Brother Shen.

text: 等人走近，乔琳宣立刻上前问好，顺势介绍周治学。
en: As they approached, Linxuan Qiao promptly stepped forward to greet them and took the opportunity to introduce Zhixue Zhou.

text: 时思遥站在身后，明显感觉周治学的身体一僵。
en: Standing behind, Siyao Shi clearly felt Zhixue Zhou's body stiffen.

text: 她立刻明白，不久前，她刚跟周治学参加过南大的校友聚会，当时祁深也在。
en: She understood at once: not long ago, she had attended a Nanda alumni gathering with Zhixue Zhou, and Shen Qi had been there too.

text: 周治学是怕祁深戳穿他们的关系。
en: Zhixue Zhou was afraid Shen Qi would expose their relationship.

text: 她嘴角扯起嘲讽弧度，同时也低下了头去。
en: A mocking curve tugged at her lips, and she lowered her head.

text: 祁深仿佛没看到她，将网球拍交给了一旁俱乐部的陪玩，开了瓶水坐下。
en: Shen Qi seemed not to see her; he handed his racket to a club companion-player standing by, opened a bottle of water and sat down.

text: 他一到，不经意的就成了中心。
en: The moment he arrived, he inadvertently became the centre of attention.

text: 傅修问他：“最后一球怎么回事？
en: Xiu Fu asked him, “What was with that last ball?

text: 祁深淡淡道：“失手。
en: Shen Qi said flatly, “A misjudgement.

text: 应承禹顿时笑了：“失手？
en: Chengyu Ying laughed at once. “A misjudgement?

text: 别是看到我们这边来了个仙女，心猿意马了吧？
en: Surely you weren't distracted, seeing a fairy arrive on our side, your mind wandering, were you?

text: 祁深喝了口水，这才顺着他的视线看了一眼时思遥。
en: Shen Qi took a sip of water before following his gaze to glance at Siyao Shi.

text: 时思遥冷不丁对上他的眼神，手下意识攥紧了。
en: Siyao Shi met his eyes abruptly and involuntarily clenched her hand.

text: 乔琳宣已经替她做介绍。
en: Linxuan Qiao had already introduced her on her behalf.

text: “祁深哥，这是时助理，治学公司的下属。
en: “Brother Shen, this is Assistant Shi, a subordinate at Zhixue's company.

text: 祁深面色平静，点了下头。
en: Shen Qi's expression was calm; he gave a nod.

text: 他放下水杯，对应承禹道：“我输是我输，技不如人，没有赖场外风景好的道理。
en: He set down his water and said to Chengyu Ying, “I lost because I lost — my skill was inferior; there's no blaming it on the fine scenery off the court.

text: 风景好？
en: Fine scenery?

text: 这是承认时思遥漂亮？
en: Did this admit that Siyao Shi was beautiful?

text: 熟悉他的人都不免诧异，多看了时思遥两眼。
en: Those who knew him could not help but be surprised, and stole a few extra glances at Siyao Shi.

text: 时思遥心砰砰地跳。
en: Siyao Shi's heart thudded.

text: 除她以为，周治学心里也慌着，这句“风景好”，总让他觉得有点嘲讽的意思。
en: Besides her, Zhixue Zhou was likewise on edge; this line about “fine scenery” always struck him as carrying a note of mockery.

text: 然而，祁深似乎对于他们的私事兴趣不大。
en: Yet Shen Qi seemed to have little interest in their private affairs.

text: 几人的话题回到了球上，祁深愿意赏脸的活动不多，网球是其中之一，他打得很好，今天却难得接连输球，不停被应承禹提起这茬。
en: The group's conversation returned to the game. There were few activities Shen Qi deigned to take part in, and tennis was one of them; he played well, yet today he had rarely lost several games in a row, and Chengyu Ying kept bringing it up.

text: 刚才打的是双人赛，跟祁深搭档的女陪玩忙站出来解释：“抱歉，是我今天身体不行，拖祁总后腿了。
en: The match just played was doubles; the female companion-player partnered with Shen Qi hurriedly stepped forward to explain, “Sorry, it's that I wasn't feeling well today and held Mr Qi back.

text: 她一说，应承禹反而来劲了，对刚才赢了祁深两局的关屹拱火：“哎，这话什么意思听出来没？
en: No sooner had she spoken than Chengyu Ying perked up instead, and egged on Yi Guan, who had just won two sets against Shen Qi, “Oi, d'you catch what she meant?

text: 这是说你能赢老祁，胜之不武呢。
en: She's saying you beat old Qi only because of her — your win wasn't exactly honourable.

text: 关屹一看就是脾气好的，却也应着笑了声，“这么一说，我有点不服了。
en: Yi Guan looked the easy-going sort, yet he laughed along, “Hearing that, I'm a bit unconvinced.

text: 他对祁深道：“起来，咱们单来一局。
en: He said to Shen Qi, “Get up — let's have a singles match.

text: 祁深勾了下唇，“歇会儿。
en: Shen Qi hooked his lip into a slight smile. “Rest a bit first.

text: “两个人打没意思，一来一回的，看着都无聊。
en: “Two people playing is no fun — just back and forth, boring to watch.

text: ”应承禹朝一旁的俱乐部经理抬了抬下巴，“去，再找个水平够的人来，替她的位置。
en: ” Chengyu Ying jerked his chin towards the club manager standing by. “Go on, find someone good enough to take her place.

text: “这还用找吗？
en: “Why go looking?

text: ”乔琳宣插了句话，又把时思遥拉出来，“我给你们带了个现成的。
en: ” Linxuan Qiao cut in and pulled Siyao Shi out again. “I've brought you a ready-made one.

text: 时思遥垂了下眼眸，乔琳宣怎么知道她会打网球？
en: Siyao Shi lowered her eyes — how did Linxuan Qiao know she could play tennis?

text: 她看了一眼周治学，只看到周治学眉心微皱。
en: She glanced at Zhixue Zhou and saw only his brows faintly knit.

text: “乔小姐，我不太会…
en: “Miss Qiao, I'm not really much good at…

text: 拒绝的话被打断，“时助理别谦虚啊，我看过你的资料，特长上写了网球。
en: Her refusal was cut short. “Assistant Shi, no need to be modest — I've seen your file; tennis is listed under special skills.

text: 时思遥瞬间反应过来，乔琳宣不是临时发现她的，是老早就注意她了。
en: In an instant Siyao Shi realised Linxuan Qiao had not discovered this on the spot — she had had her eye on her for a long time.

text: 为什么？
en: Why?

text: 她来不及多想，转脸时，再次和祁深对上眼神。
en: She had no time to ponder; as she turned her face, she met Shen Qi's eyes once more.

text: “会打吗？
en: Can you play?

text: ”他用词吝惜，让人觉得态度不冷不热。
en: ” His words were sparse, giving the impression of an indifferent manner.

text: 时思遥张了张口。
en: Siyao Shi opened her mouth.

text: 一旁，周治学忽然说：“能跟祁总打球不容易，机会难得。
en: Beside them, Zhixue Zhou suddenly said, “It is not easy to get to play with Mr Qi; the chance is rare.

text: 时思遥明白，他这还是怕祁深“戳穿他们”，急着跟她撇清关系。
en: Siyao Shi understood — he was still afraid Shen Qi would “expose them”, and was eager to distance himself from her.

text: 她舒了口气，仍旧回绝：“我打得不好，怕拖祁总后腿。
en: She breathed a sigh of relief and still declined. “I don't play well; I'm afraid I'd hold Mr Qi back.

text: “我们祁总带着个身体不舒服的搭档，对手都只是险胜，你得打多差，才能拖他后腿？
en: Our Mr Qi played with a partner who wasn't feeling well, and the opponents only just scraped a win — how badly would you have to play to hold him back?

text: ”应承禹调侃，一脸等着看好戏的表情。
en: ” Chengyu Ying teased, wearing an expression of one waiting for the show to begin.

text: 祁深没看时思遥：“别勉强。
en: Shen Qi did not look at Siyao Shi. “Don't force yourself.

text: “不勉强，时助理只是不好意思。
en: She's not forcing it — Assistant Shi is just being shy.

text: ”乔琳宣说着，仿佛跟时思遥认识很多年了似的。
en: ” Linxuan Qiao said, as if she had known Siyao Shi for years.

text: 祁深一起身，她就顺势把时思遥推了出去。
en: The moment Shen Qi stood up, she took the chance to push Siyao Shi forward.

text: 时思遥快速稳住身形，才避免了撞到祁深。
en: Siyao Shi quickly steadied herself, just avoiding colliding with Shen Qi.

text: 前方，关屹已经和搭档进场了。
en: Ahead, Yi Guan and his partner had already entered the court.

text: 祁深走在了前面，时思遥也只好跟上去。
en: Shen Qi walked ahead, and Siyao Shi had no choice but to follow.

text: 进了球场，关屹两人远远在对面，虽然是露天空间，但某种程度上，算是独处。
en: Once on court, Yi Guan and his partner were far across on the other side; though it was an open-air space, in a sense it counted as being alone together.

text: 俩人一路无话，选球拍时，祁深才问一句。
en: The two walked on without a word; only when choosing rackets did Shen Qi ask.

text: “用几号球拍？
en: “What number racket do you use?

text: 时思遥定了定神：“三号。
en: Siyao Shi composed herself. “Number three.

text: 闻言，祁深眼底微起诧异。
en: At this, a flicker of surprise rose in Shen Qi's eyes.

text: 她这样弱不惊风的，还以为她习惯用“一号”。
en: She looked so delicate, he had assumed she would favour a “number one”.

text: 工具柜就在一旁，他开了柜门：“最上面是三号。
en: The equipment cabinet was right there; he opened its door. “The top one is number three.

text: 时思遥应了声。
en: Siyao Shi murmured assent.

text: 男人拿着球拍从她身边经过，态度依然不热络，仅仅是问了个球拍而已。
en: The man walked past her with the racket, his manner still cool — he had merely asked about a racket.

text: 然而，时思遥垫脚拿球拍的瞬间，听到他说。
en: Yet the moment Siyao Shi rose on tiptoe to take the racket, she heard him say.

text: “高跟鞋换掉。
en: “Change out of the high heels.

text: 场中开了球，场外，应承禹等人观战。
en: On court the game began; off court, Chengyu Ying and the others watched.

text: 乔琳宣走近了看，男人们坐着。
en: Linxuan Qiao moved closer to watch; the men remained seated.

text: 傅修喝了口水，不经意地开口：“周总是做软件开发的？
en: Xiu Fu took a sip of water and remarked offhandedly, “Mr Zhou is in software development?

text: 周治学以为他感兴趣，应了一声。
en: Zhixue Zhou, thinking him interested, gave a murmur of assent.

text: 傅修身子后靠，看了一眼不远处的乔琳宣，“有乔大小姐在，以后，周总还能拓展点业务。
en: Xiu Fu leaned back and glanced at Linxuan Qiao not far off. “With Young Miss Qiao around, Mr Zhou will be able to expand his business a bit in future.

text: 应承禹听出点意思来，挑了挑眉：“比如？
en: Chengyu Ying caught the implication and raised an eyebrow. “Such as?

text: “人力资源。
en: “Human resources.

text: 应承禹笑了。
en: Chengyu Ying laughed.

text: 什么人力资源，拉皮条还差不多。
en: What human resources — more like pimping.

text: 装偶遇就算了，还带个漂亮助理过来，无非是想趁机往他们身边送，拿美人做人情。
en: Passing it off as a chance encounter was bad enough, but bringing a pretty assistant along — all he wants is to seize the chance to send her their way and curry favour with beauty.

text: 周治学嘴角微僵。
en: Zhixue Zhou's mouth stiffened slightly.

text: 他当然听得出傅修的嘲讽，可也无话可说，只能暗骂乔琳宣愚蠢，弄巧成拙。
en: Of course he could hear Xiu Fu's mockery, yet had nothing to say, able only to curse Linxuan Qiao inwardly for her foolishness — she had defeated her own purpose.

text: 场内
en: On court

text: 你来我往，连着上百个回合，不分胜负。
en: The two traded shots, over a hundred rallies running, neither gaining the upper hand.

text: 怦！
en: Thwack!

text: 结实的球拍撞击球体的声音，是时思遥将一记险球打了回去！
en: The solid sound of racket striking ball — it was Siyao Shi returning a difficult shot!

text: 场外，应承禹毫不掩饰地给她喝彩。
en: Off court, Chengyu Ying cheered her without restraint.

text: “好球！
en: “Good shot!

text: 祁深也看了她一眼，目中不乏赞赏。
en: Shen Qi too glanced at her, his eyes not without admiration.

text: 只是视线落在她胸口，他目光不动声色地收了回去，然后反手将一记正面球打了回去。
en: But as his gaze fell on her chest, he withdrew it without a flicker, then returned a straight shot with a backhand.

text: 他这一下力道太猛，球速也太快，角度更是刁钻，女搭档没接得住，关屹也没来得及补救。
en: His stroke was too forceful, the ball too fast, the angle too tricky; the female partner could not return it, nor could Yi Guan intervene in time.

text: 第一局，胜。
en: First set, won.

text: 时思遥大口大口地喘着气，她中午吃得少，此刻剧烈运动一下，只觉心慌。
en: Siyao Shi panted heavily; she had eaten little at noon, and now after the strenuous exercise she felt panicky.

text: 本以为下一局又要开始，祁深却中途叫了停。
en: She had thought the next set would begin, yet Shen Qi called a halt midway.

text: 她有些诧异，看了他一眼。
en: She was a little surprised and glanced at him.

text: 祁深说是换球拍，回来时，却将一样小东西不经意地丢给了她。
en: Shen Qi said it was to change rackets; when he returned, however, he casually tossed her a small object.

text: 她艰难接过，确定没人发现，才低头去看。
en: She caught it with difficulty and, only after making sure no one had noticed, looked down at it.

text: 一枚钉针式袖扣。
en: A pin-style cufflink.

text: 正忙完，祁深淡声提醒：“扣子。
en: Just as she finished, Shen Qi reminded her softly, “Your button.

text: 她低头一看，登时，脸上涨红。
en: She looked down and instantly her face flushed crimson.

text: 白色衬衫胸口处的扣子，不知何时崩掉了一颗，她不动作，文胸和肌肤都露出来了，更何况是刚才大开大合地起落。
en: A button on the chest of her white shirt had come off at some point; if she did not act, her bra and skin were showing — all the more so after the wide, sweeping movements just now.

text: 对面已经在催促开局，她用袖扣钉住了绷开的地方，快速说了句：“谢谢祁总。
en: The other side was already urging the game to start; she pinned the gap shut with the cufflink and said quickly, “Thank you, Mr Qi.

text: 有外人时，她没叫教授。
en: When there were outsiders, she had not called him Professor.

text: 现在没人了，她也没叫。
en: Now that no one was around, she still did not.

text: 祁深没应。
en: Shen Qi did not respond.

text: 不为别的。
en: Not for any other reason.

text: 只是祁总两个字，从她嘴里出来，不大顺耳。
en: It was simply that the two words “Mr Qi” did not sit quite right coming from her lips.

text: 新一局开始。
en: The new set began.

text: 冰凉的袖扣，两面都是宝石。
en: The cool cufflink, gemstones on both faces.

text: 随着跳跃，很容易触碰到皮肤。
en: With each jump, it easily brushed against her skin.

text: 每一次，都让时思遥想起那天在酒店，祁深冰凉的手指，还有他手指上的戒指。
en: Each time, it reminded Siyao Shi of that day in the hotel — Shen Qi's cool fingers, and the ring on his finger.

text: 情绪压力下，她体力又不支，第二轮明显就不行了。
en: Under emotional strain and with her stamina failing, she was clearly out of sorts by the second round.

text: 为了不让祁深一直替她补漏，她硬着头皮往下撑。
en: To keep Shen Qi from constantly covering for her, she soldiered on against her better judgement.

text: 到第三轮，她几乎是机械地作出回应，恍惚间，球从对面朝她这里飞过来。
en: By the third round she was responding almost mechanically; in a daze, the ball came flying towards her from across the net.

text: 她试图跳起，却怎么也没力气了。
en: She tried to jump, but had no strength left.

text: 忽然。
en: Suddenly.

text: 怦！
en: Thwack!

text: 有人挡在她身前，把球打了回去！
en: Someone stepped in front of her and hit the ball back!

text: 她松口气的同时，来不及去看战况，接连踉跄着往后退。
en: Even as she breathed a sigh of relief, with no time to see the play, she staggered backwards in succession.

text: 眼见要摔倒，一样硬物横在了她腰后，阻止了她后退的脚步。
en: Just as she was about to fall, a hard object slid horizontally behind her waist, stopping her backward step.

text: 耳边是连绵急促的喘气声，还有她的心跳声，仔细听，又似乎混着另外一个人的。
en: By her ear came continuous ragged breaths, and her own heartbeat; listening closely, it seemed to mingle with another's.

text: 手臂贴到温热的物体，她才反应过来，是祁深握着球拍的手，托住她腰的，是他的球拍。
en: Only when her arm touched something warm did she realise — it was Shen Qi's hand gripping the racket, and what propped up her waist was his racket.

text: 他们并列，说近，他并没有直接接触她，说远，甚至能感受到他身上的热传过来。
en: They stood side by side; close, yet he did not touch her directly; far, yet she could feel the heat from his body reaching her.

text: 只有两秒的停顿。
en: Only a two-second pause.

text: 她克服了腿软，不动声色地从他身侧离开。
en: She overcame her weak knees and slipped away from his side without a trace of expression.

text: “谢谢祁总。
en: “Thank you, Mr Qi.

text: 又是祁总。
en: “Mr Qi” again.

text: 祁深唇瓣微抿，应了一声。
en: Shen Qi's lips pressed together slightly, and he gave a murmur of acknowledgement.

text: 关屹的女搭档跑到了网边。
en: Yi Guan's female partner ran to the net.

text: “时助理，你没事吧？
en: “Assistant Shi, are you all right?

text: 时思遥缓和过来，点头应声。
en: Siyao Shi recovered and nodded in reply.

text: “抱歉，我有点体力不支。
en: “Sorry, I'm a bit worn out.

text: “没事的，咱们哪能跟祁总他们比体力啊。
en: “It's all right — how could we compare physically with Mr Qi and the others?

text: 时思遥脸色明显不太好，关屹也不揪着，招呼祁深下场。
en: Siyao Shi's complexion was clearly poor, and Yi Guan did not press the matter, calling Shen Qi off the court.

text: 眼看祁深要出球场，时思遥试图把袖扣摘下来，可想想上面都是她的汗，她又止住了动作。
en: Seeing Shen Qi about to leave the court, Siyao Shi tried to remove the cufflink, but thinking it was covered in her sweat, she stopped herself.

text: 算了，他大概也不差一枚袖扣。
en: Never mind — he probably didn't lack for a single cufflink.

text: 上次已经是意外，知道他已婚，以后永远别再见才是上上大吉。
en: Last time was already an accident; now that she knew he was married, the best fortune of all would be never to meet again.

text: 她这么想着，慢了两步，祁深已经走远。
en: Thinking thus, she lagged a couple of steps, and Shen Qi had already walked far off.

text: 回到遮阳篷下，乔琳宣给她拿了支藿香正气水，好心地关心她。
en: Back under the sunshade, Linxuan Qiao fetched her a bottle of huoxiang zhengqi syrup and kindly fussed over her.

text: 她刚喝完，应承禹就开了口。
en: No sooner had she finished it than Chengyu Ying spoke up.

text: “时助理大学专业不是财务管理吧。
en: “Assistant Shi's university major wasn't financial management, was it?

text: 时思遥不解，朝他看了过去。
en: Siyao Shi was puzzled and looked over at him.

text: 应承禹和关屹对视一眼，面带戏谑：“我猜，你专业应该是修道，否则，心怎么这么冷？
en: Chengyu Ying exchanged a glance with Yi Guan, a teasing look on his face. “I'd guess your major was cultivation — otherwise, how could your heart be so cold?

text: 他身子后靠，又看了一眼祁深。
en: He leaned back and glanced at Shen Qi again.

text: “我们祁总这么个黄金单身汉在你身边站着，你竟然全程目不斜视，真冷漠啊。
en: “Our Mr Qi, a golden bachelor, standing right beside you, and you kept your eyes straight ahead the whole time — how cold-hearted.

text: 时思遥愣了下，随即眼神一晃。
en: Siyao Shi was startled for a moment, then her eyes wavered.

text: 祁深，单身？
en: Shen Qi, single?

text: 她还没弄清楚，一旁的女陪玩忍不住问她。
en: Before she could make sense of it, the female companion-player beside her could not help but ask.

text: “时助理这么漂亮肯定早就有男朋友了吧？
en: “Assistant Shi, being so pretty, you must have had a boyfriend for ages, surely?
